Mctt.Core.Syntactic.System.Lemmas

Properties of the Judgments, continued

Everything here uses presupposition, which Global/Presup.v proves by a mutual induction over all the judgments; the structural properties it relies on are in Structural.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia Classes.RelationClasses Setoid Morphisms.

From Mctt Require Import LibTactics.
From Mctt.Core Require Import Base.
From Mctt.Core.Syntactic.System.Global Require Export Presup.
Import Syntax_Notations Wk_Notations.
#[local] Open Scope list_scope.

Presupposition for Typing

presup_exp_typ is proved in Global/Presup.v, from the mutual theorem.

Corollary presup_exp : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M A},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵗ A.
Proof.
  intros; split; [ mauto 2 | eapply presup_exp_typ; eassumption ].
Qed.

Context Conversion of Substitutions

Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ˢ Id : Γ transports substitutions too: compose with the inclusion and cancel the identity. Which side it goes on is what distinguishes the two: ctxsub_sub refines the domain, ctxsub_sub_cod coarsens the codomain.

Corollary ctxsub_sub : forall Θ Ξ Γ Γ' Δ σ,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ˢ Id : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ˢ σ : Δ.
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite <- (sb_compose_id_right σ); mauto 2.
Qed.

Corollary ctxsub_sub_cod : forall Θ Ξ Γ Γ' Δ σ,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ Id : Γ' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ˢ σ : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ˢ σ : Γ'.
Proof.
  intros.
  rewrite <- (sb_compose_id_left σ); mauto 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve ctxsub_sub : mctt.

Substitution Equivalence

The closure properties below are the wf_sub_eq counterparts of wf_sub_id–wf_sub_q. Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ equates the images at A[σ], so symmetry and transitivity need A[σ] and A[σ'] to be equal types. That is sub_eq_preserves_exp, which therefore comes first, and the PER instance last.

Lemma sentry_modexp_wk : forall e φ, sentry_modexp (sentry_wk e φ) = modexp_wk (sentry_modexp e) φ.
Proof. intros [] φ; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sentry_modexp_sub : forall e τ, sentry_modexp (sentry_sub e τ) = (sentry_modexp e)[τ]ᵐ.
Proof. intros [] τ; reflexivity. Qed.

What a well-typed substitution sends a module slot to is a well-formed module expression.
Lemma wf_sub_mod_image : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ x U,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ : Δ -> Δ ∋ #x ≔ₘ U -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ sentry_modexp (σ x) ≈ sentry_modexp (σ x).
Proof.
  intros * Hσ Hl; destruct (wf_sub_apply_mod _ _ _ _ _ Hσ _ _ Hl) as [[-> HU] | (y & -> & Hy)]; cbn.
  - apply wf_me_lit; exact HU.
  - eapply wf_me_var; [ exact (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) | exact Hy ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_sub_eq_refl : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ : Δ.
Proof.
  intros; econstructor; [ mauto 2 | mauto 2 | mauto 2 | intros; eapply wf_sub_mod_image; eassumption ].
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_sub_eq_refl : mctt.

Lemma sub_eq_preserves_vlookup : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ' x A,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Δ ∋ #x : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] ≈ #x[σ'] : A[σ].
Proof.
  intros; eapply wf_sub_eq_apply; eassumption.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve sub_eq_preserves_vlookup : mctt.

saturate_sub_eq plays the role saturate_sub does for sub_preserves_wf: it injects the two typing components of every substitution equivalence in context, so that all the mauto calls below can reach them.

Ltac saturate_sub_eq :=
  match_by_head wf_sub_eq ltac:(fun H => pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ H);
                                         pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ H));
  clear_dups;
  saturate_sub.

Corollary ctxsub_sub_eq : forall Θ Ξ Γ Γ' Δ σ σ',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ˢ Id : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ.
Proof.
  intros * ? H; saturate_sub_eq.
  econstructor; [ mauto 2 | mauto 2 | |].
  - intros x A ?.
    eapply ctxsub_exp_eq; mauto 2.
  - intros x U Hl; rewrite <- (modexp_sub_id (sentry_modexp (σ x))), <- (modexp_sub_id (sentry_modexp (σ' x))).
    eapply sub_preserves_modexp; [ eapply wf_sub_eq_apply_mod; eassumption | eassumption ].
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve ctxsub_sub_eq : mctt.

The tempting justification of the second component is "sub_preserves_exp_eq applied to reflexivity", which does not give it: sub_preserves_wf transports along a single substitution and so only yields A[σ] ≈ A[σ]. The equation really comes from sub_eq_preserves_exp, which is proved by an induction that appeals to this lemma. We break the cycle by taking the equation as a premise; that is precisely what the induction hypothesis for the domain supplies at every use site.

Lemma wf_sub_eq_q : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ' κ A Srt,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ A : Srt ->
    sort_kind Srt κ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ A[σ'] : Srt ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κ} A[σ] ⊢ˢ q σ ≈ q σ' : Δ ▹{κ} A.
Proof.
  intros * H ? HS ?; saturate_sub_eq.
  pose proof (sort_kind_type_sort _ _ HS) as HS0.
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : Srt) by mauto 2.
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A[σ'] : Srt) by mauto 2.
  assert (⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κ} A[σ]) by mauto 2.
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κ} A[σ] ⊢ʷ ↑ : Γ) by mauto 2.
  econstructor; [ mauto 2 | | |].
  - eapply ctxsub_sub; [ eapply wf_sub_id_extend_eq; mauto 2 | mauto 2 ].
  - intros x B Hlk.
    inversion Hlk; subst; reduce_index; rewrite exp_wk_shift_sub_q; [ mauto 3 | ].
    rewrite <- !sentry_exp_wk; fold (exp_sub (a_var n) σ) (exp_sub (a_var n) σ').
    eapply wk_preserves_exp_eq; [ eapply wf_sub_eq_apply; eassumption | eassumption ].
  - intros x U Hlk; inversion Hlk; subst;
    match goal with Hl0 : _ ∋ # ?n ≔ₘ _ |- _ =>
      change (sb_q σ (S n)) with (sentry_wk (σ n) wk_shift); change (sb_q σ' (S n)) with (sentry_wk (σ' n) wk_shift);
      rewrite !sentry_modexp_wk; eapply wk_preserves_modexp; [ eapply wf_sub_eq_apply_mod; eassumption | eassumption ] end.
Qed.

The same over a definition, with the substituted bodies equal as a premise for the same reason.
Lemma wf_sub_eq_q_def : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ' A M Srt,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ A : Srt ->
    type_sort Srt ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ A[σ'] : Srt ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M[σ] ≈ M[σ'] : A[σ] ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▸ A[σ] ≔ M[σ] ⊢ˢ q σ ≈ q σ' : Δ ▸ A ≔ M.
Proof.
  intros * H ? HS ? ? ?; saturate_sub_eq.
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A[σ] : Srt) by mauto 2.
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A[σ'] : Srt) by mauto 2.
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M[σ] : A[σ]) by mauto 2.
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M[σ'] : A[σ']) by mauto 2.
  assert (⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▸ A[σ] ≔ M[σ]) by mauto 2.
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▸ A[σ] ≔ M[σ] ⊢ʷ ↑ : Γ) by mauto 2.
  econstructor; [ mauto 2 | | |].
  - assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A[σ'] ≈ A[σ] : Srt) by mauto 2.
    assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M[σ'] ≈ M[σ] : A[σ']) by
      (eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp'; [ symmetry; eassumption | eapply wf_subtyp_refl; eassumption ]).
    eapply ctxsub_sub; [ eapply (wf_sub_id_extend_def_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Srt); try eassumption; mauto 2 | mauto 2 ].
  - intros x B Hlk.
    inversion Hlk; subst; reduce_index; rewrite exp_wk_shift_sub_q; [ mauto 3 | ].
    rewrite <- !sentry_exp_wk; fold (exp_sub (a_var n) σ) (exp_sub (a_var n) σ').
    eapply wk_preserves_exp_eq; [ eapply wf_sub_eq_apply; eassumption | eassumption ].
  - intros x U Hlk; inversion Hlk; subst;
    match goal with Hl0 : _ ∋ # ?n ≔ₘ _ |- _ =>
      change (sb_q σ (S n)) with (sentry_wk (σ n) wk_shift); change (sb_q σ' (S n)) with (sentry_wk (σ' n) wk_shift);
      rewrite !sentry_modexp_wk; eapply wk_preserves_modexp; [ eapply wf_sub_eq_apply_mod; eassumption | eassumption ] end.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_sub_eq_q wf_sub_eq_q_def : mctt.

Lemma wf_sub_eq_extend : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ' κ A M M' Srt,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ A : Srt ->
    sort_kind Srt κ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A[σ] ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M' : A[σ'] ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A[σ] ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ,,M ≈ σ',,M' : Δ ▹{κ} A.
Proof.
  intros * H HA HS ? ? ?; saturate_sub_eq.
  econstructor; [ eapply wf_sub_extend; eassumption | eapply wf_sub_extend; eassumption | |].
  - intros x B Hlk.
    inversion Hlk; subst; reduce_index; rewrite exp_sub_shift_extend;
      [ assumption | eapply wf_sub_eq_apply; eassumption ].
  - intros x U Hlk; inversion Hlk; subst; cbn; eapply wf_sub_eq_apply_mod; eassumption.
Qed.

The instance every elimination rule needs: two single substitutions of equal terms. Stating it separately is what keeps exp_sub_id out of the call sites, which would otherwise have to rewrite A[Id] to A three times over.
Corollary wf_sub_eq_id_extend : forall Θ Ξ Γ κ A M M' Srt,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Srt ->
    sort_kind Srt κ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M' : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ Id,,M ≈ Id,,M' : Γ ▹{κ} A.
Proof.
  intros.
  assert (⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ) by mauto 2.
  apply (wf_sub_eq_extend Θ Ξ Γ Γ sb_id sb_id κ A M M' Srt);
    [ mauto 3 | assumption | assumption
    | rewrite exp_sub_id; assumption
    | rewrite exp_sub_id; assumption
    | rewrite exp_sub_id; assumption ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_sub_eq_extend_def : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ' A M N N' Srt,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ A : Srt ->
    type_sort Srt ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : A[σ] ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N' : A[σ'] ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N ≈ M[σ] : A[σ] ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N' ≈ M[σ'] : A[σ'] ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N ≈ N' : A[σ] ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ,,N ≈ σ',,N' : Δ ▸ A ≔ M.
Proof.
  intros * H HA HS ? ? ? ? ? ?; saturate_sub_eq.
  econstructor; [ eapply wf_sub_extend_def; eassumption | eapply wf_sub_extend_def; eassumption | |].
  - intros x B Hlk.
    inversion Hlk; subst; reduce_index; rewrite exp_sub_shift_extend;
      [ assumption | eapply wf_sub_eq_apply; eassumption ].
  - intros x U Hlk; inversion Hlk; subst; cbn; eapply wf_sub_eq_apply_mod; eassumption.
Qed.

Corollary wf_sub_eq_id_extend_def : forall Θ Ξ Γ A M M' Srt,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Srt ->
    type_sort Srt ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M' : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ Id,,M ≈ Id,,M' : Γ ▸ A ≔ M.
Proof.
  intros.
  assert (⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ) by mauto 2.
  apply (wf_sub_eq_extend_def Θ Ξ Γ Γ sb_id sb_id A M M M' Srt);
    rewrite ?exp_sub_id; mauto 3.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sub_eq_wk : forall Θ Ξ Γ Γ' Δ σ σ' φ,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ʷ φ : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ˢ (sb_wk σ φ) ≈ (sb_wk σ' φ) : Δ.
Proof.
  intros * H ?; saturate_wk; saturate_sub_eq.
  econstructor; [ mauto 2 | mauto 2 | |].
  - intros x A ?; reduce_index; rewrite <- exp_wk_sub, <- !sentry_exp_wk; fold (exp_sub (a_var x) σ) (exp_sub (a_var x) σ').
    eapply wk_preserves_exp_eq; [ eapply wf_sub_eq_apply; eassumption | eassumption ].
  - intros x U Hl; cbn [sb_wk]; rewrite !sentry_modexp_wk.
    eapply wk_preserves_modexp; [ eapply wf_sub_eq_apply_mod; eassumption | eassumption ].
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_sub_eq_extend wf_sub_eq_id_extend wf_sub_eq_extend_def wf_sub_eq_id_extend_def
             wf_sub_eq_wk : mctt.

Extending equivalent substitutions into a module slot, each by the literal of its own transported unit, the two transported units being equal.
Lemma wf_sub_eq_extend_mod : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ' U,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U[σ]ᵘ ≈ U[σ']ᵘ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ,,ₘ me_lit U[σ]ᵘ ≈ σ' ,,ₘ me_lit U[σ']ᵘ : Δ ▹ₘ U.
Proof.
  intros * H ? HUσ; saturate_sub_eq.
  econstructor; [ apply wf_sub_extend_mod; eauto using sub_preserves_unit
                | apply wf_sub_extend_mod; eauto using sub_preserves_unit | |].
  - intros x B Hlk.
    inversion Hlk; subst; reduce_index; rewrite exp_sub_shift_extend; eapply wf_sub_eq_apply; eassumption.
  - intros x U0 Hlk; inversion Hlk; subst; cbn; [ apply wf_me_lit; exact HUσ | eapply wf_sub_eq_apply_mod; eassumption ].
Qed.

Extending equivalent substitutions into a definition with a module part, each by its own term, equal to the transported body, and the literal of its own transported unit, the two units being equal.
Lemma wf_sub_eq_extend_dm : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ' A M E N N' i,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵘ gu_mk nil (md_alias E) ≈ gu_mk nil (md_alias E) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N : A[σ] ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N' : A[σ'] ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N ≈ M[σ] : A[σ] ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N' ≈ M[σ'] : A[σ'] ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N ≈ N' : A[σ] ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ (gu_mk nil (md_alias E))[σ]ᵘ ≈ (gu_mk nil (md_alias E))[σ']ᵘ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ,,ᵈ N ‖ me_lit (gu_mk nil (md_alias E))[σ]ᵘ ≈ σ' ,,ᵈ N' ‖ me_lit (gu_mk nil (md_alias E))[σ']ᵘ
      : Δ ▸ₘ A ≔ M ‖ gu_mk nil (md_alias E).
Proof.
  intros * H HA HM HU ? ? ? ? ? HUσ; saturate_sub_eq.
  econstructor; [ eapply wf_sub_extend_dm; eauto using sub_preserves_unit
                | eapply wf_sub_extend_dm; eauto using sub_preserves_unit | |].
  - intros x B Hlk.
    inversion Hlk; subst; reduce_index; rewrite exp_sub_shift_extend;
      [ assumption | eapply wf_sub_eq_apply; eassumption ].
  - intros x U0 Hlk; inversion Hlk; subst; cbn; [ apply wf_me_lit; exact HUσ | eapply wf_sub_eq_apply_mod; eassumption ].
Qed.

A substituted local definition with a module part is its body under the substitution extended by the transported term and unit (ζ).
Lemma let_dm_sub_zeta : forall Θ Ξ Γ0 Γ s A M E B C S i,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˢ s : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_mk nil (md_alias E) ≈ gu_mk nil (md_alias E) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▸ₘ A ≔ M ‖ gu_mk nil (md_alias E) ⊢ C : S ->
    type_sort S ->
    module_body_sort S ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▸ₘ A ≔ M ‖ gu_mk nil (md_alias E) ⊢ B : C ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ ℓᵈ A[s] ≔ M[s] ‖ (gu_mk nil (md_alias E))[s]ᵘ in B[q s]
      ≈ B[s ,,ᵈ M[s] ‖ me_lit (gu_mk nil (md_alias E))[s]ᵘ] : C[s ,,ᵈ M[s] ‖ me_lit (gu_mk nil (md_alias E))[s]ᵘ].
Proof.
  intros * Hs HA HM HU HC HS Hm HB.
  assert (HUs : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵘ (gu_mk nil (md_alias E))[s]ᵘ ≈ (gu_mk nil (md_alias E))[s]ᵘ)
    by (eapply sub_preserves_unit; eassumption).
  pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA Hs) as HAs; cbn in HAs.
  pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hs) as HMs.
  rewrite <- (exp_sub_q_extend_dm B), <- (exp_sub_q_extend_dm C).
  rewrite gunit_sub_mk in HUs |- *; cbn [tele_sub moddef_sub List.length sb_qn] in HUs |- *.
  assert (Hq : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ▸ₘ A[s] ≔ M[s] ‖ gu_mk nil (md_alias E[s]ᵐ) ⊢ˢ q s : Γ ▸ₘ A ≔ M ‖ gu_mk nil (md_alias E))
    by (eapply wf_sub_q_dm; eassumption).
  eapply wf_exp_eq_let_dm_zeta;
    [ exact HAs | exact HMs | exact HUs
    | eapply sub_preserves_sort; [ exact HC | exact HS | exact Hq ]
    | exact HS | exact Hm
    | eapply sub_preserves_exp; [ exact HB | exact Hq ] ].
Qed.

Two sides reduced to equal terms, at types that are equal.
Lemma wf_exp_eq_meet : forall Θ Ξ Γ L N N' L' T T' Srt,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ L ≈ N : T ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N ≈ N' : T ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ L' ≈ N' : T' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ T : Srt ->
    type_sort Srt ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ T ≈ T' : Srt ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ L ≈ L' : T.
Proof.
  intros * ? ? ? ? HS ?.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ eassumption |].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ eassumption |].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_sym, wf_exp_eq_subtyp'; [ eassumption |].
  eapply wf_subtyp_refl; [ eassumption | exact HS | eapply wf_exp_eq_sym; eassumption ].
Qed.

Equivalent Substitutions Preserve Typing

This is about typing derivations only, so it is a plain induction on wf_exp: the subtyping premise of wf_exp_subtyp is discharged by sub_preserves_subtyp rather than by an induction hypothesis. Because wf_exp_eq_elim_cong lets the motive vary, the presupposition lemma needs to move a type along an equivalence of substitutions, that is, it needs this lemma. Its counterparts for equality and subtyping (sub_eq_preserves_exp_eq, sub_eq_preserves_subtyp) in turn need presupposition for the symmetry case, and so come after it, in Core.Syntactic.SubEq.

Ltac lift_sub_eq_step :=
  match goal with
  | Hσ : wf_sub_eq ?Θ ?Ξ ?Γ ?Δ ?σ ?σ',
    _ : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq ?Θ ?Ξ _ (cons (ce_ass ?κ ?A) ?Δ) _ _ -> _,
    IH : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq ?Θ ?Ξ _ ?Δ _ _ -> wf_exp_eq ?Θ ?Ξ _ ?S (exp_sub ?A _) _ |- _ =>
      let T := constr:(Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ cons (ce_ass κ (exp_sub A σ)) Γ ⊢ˢ sb_q σ ≈ sb_q σ' : cons (ce_ass κ A) Δ) in
      assert_fails (assert T by assumption);
      assert T by (eapply (wf_sub_eq_q _ _ _ _ _ _ κ _ S); [ exact Hσ | | constructor | exact (IH _ _ _ Hσ) ]; mauto 2)
  
A domain in a small universe, at a level it is given to be one: both are moved into the least large universe.
  | Hσ : wf_sub_eq ?Θ ?Ξ ?Γ ?Δ ?σ ?σ',
    _ : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq ?Θ ?Ξ _ (cons (ce_ass ak_relevant ?A) ?Δ) _ _ -> _,
    HL : wf_exp ?Θ ?Ξ ?Δ (a_level ?n) ?L,
    HA : wf_exp ?Θ ?Ξ ?Δ (a_univ ?L) ?A,
    IH : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq ?Θ ?Ξ _ ?Δ _ _ -> wf_exp_eq ?Θ ?Ξ _ (a_univ _) (exp_sub ?A _) _ |- _ =>
      let T := constr:(Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ cons (ce_ass ak_relevant (exp_sub A σ)) Γ ⊢ˢ sb_q σ ≈ sb_q σ' : cons (ce_ass ak_relevant A) Δ) in
      assert_fails (assert T by assumption);
      assert T by (eapply (wf_sub_eq_q _ _ _ _ _ _ ak_relevant _ (a_typ 0));
                   [ exact Hσ | exact (wf_exp_suniv_large HL HA) | constructor
                   | eapply wf_exp_eq_suniv_large; [| exact (IH _ _ _ Hσ) ];
                     let HLs := fresh "HLs" in
                     pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HL (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ)) as HLs;
                     exact HLs ])
  end.

Ltac lift_sub_eq_def :=
  match goal with
  | Hσ : wf_sub_eq ?Θ ?Ξ ?Γ ?Δ ?σ ?σ',
    _ : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq ?Θ ?Ξ _ (cons (ce_def ?A ?M) ?Δ) _ _ -> _,
    IHA : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq ?Θ ?Ξ _ ?Δ _ _ -> wf_exp_eq ?Θ ?Ξ _ ?S (exp_sub ?A _) _,
    IHM : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq ?Θ ?Ξ _ ?Δ _ _ -> wf_exp_eq ?Θ ?Ξ _ (exp_sub ?A _) (exp_sub ?M _) _ |- _ =>
      let T := constr:(Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ cons (ce_def (exp_sub A σ) (exp_sub M σ)) Γ ⊢ˢ sb_q σ ≈ sb_q σ' : cons (ce_def A M) Δ) in
      assert_fails (assert T by assumption);
      assert T by (eapply (wf_sub_eq_q_def _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ S); [ exact Hσ | | constructor | | exact (IHA _ _ _ Hσ) | exact (IHM _ _ _ Hσ) ]; mauto 2)
  end.

Ltac lift_sub_eq := repeat first [ lift_sub_eq_step | lift_sub_eq_def ].

saturate_sub_typ and saturate_sub_eq_IH are the counterparts of push_sub/lift_sub for the equivalence induction: the first transports every type premise along every substitution in context, the second instantiates every induction hypothesis at every substitution equivalence in context. Together they leave all the premises of the congruence rule literally in the context, so that the search never has to guess a domain type through an evar.

Ltac saturate_sub_typ :=
  repeat match goal with
  | H : wf_exp ?Θ ?Ξ ?Δ (a_typ ?i) ?A, Hσ : wf_sub ?Θ ?Ξ ?Γ ?Δ ?σ |- _ =>
      let T := constr:(Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ exp_sub A σ : a_typ i) in
      assert_fails (assert T by assumption);
      assert T by (eapply sub_preserves_typ; eassumption)
  | H : wf_exp ?Θ ?Ξ ?Δ (a_univ ?i) ?A, Hσ : wf_sub ?Θ ?Ξ ?Γ ?Δ ?σ |- _ =>
      let T := constr:(Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ exp_sub A σ : a_univ i) in
      assert_fails (assert T by assumption);
      assert T by (eapply sub_preserves_styp; eassumption)
  | H : wf_exp ?Θ ?Ξ ?Δ a_prop ?A, Hσ : wf_sub ?Θ ?Ξ ?Γ ?Δ ?σ |- _ =>
      let T := constr:(Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ exp_sub A σ : a_prop) in
      assert_fails (assert T by assumption);
      assert T by (eapply sub_preserves_sort; [ exact H | constructor | exact Hσ ])
  end.

Ltac saturate_sub_eq_IH :=
  repeat match goal with
  | IH : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ ?Δ _ _ -> _, Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ ?Δ _ _ |- _ =>
      let T := type of (IH _ _ _ Hσ) in
      assert_fails (assert T by assumption);
      pose proof (IH _ _ _ Hσ)
  end.

The parts of an equation of telescopes ending in assumptions A and A': the telescopes before, the heads each at its own sort, and each head below the other in the left telescope.
#[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
Record ext_eq_ass_head (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ Ψ Ψ' : ctx) (κ : abs_kind) (A A' : typ) : Prop := mk_ext_eq_ass_head
  {
The sort of the left head
    ext_head_sort_left : exp
    
It is a sort of the heads' kind
  ; ext_head_sort_left_ok : sort_kind ext_head_sort_left κ
    
The sort of the right head
  ; ext_head_sort_right : exp
    
It is a sort of the heads' kind
  ; ext_head_sort_right_ok : sort_kind ext_head_sort_right κ
    
The telescopes before the heads are equal
  ; ext_head_tail : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ'
    
The left head is of its sort, in the left telescope
  ; ext_head_left : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ ⊢ A : ext_head_sort_left
    
The right head is of its sort, in the right telescope
  ; ext_head_right : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ' ++ Γ ⊢ A' : ext_head_sort_right
    
The left head is below the right one, in the left telescope
  ; ext_head_sub : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A'
    
and the right one below the left one
  ; ext_head_sub_rev : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Γ ⊢ A' ⊆ A }.

The head of an equation of telescopes of assumptions.
Lemma ext_eq_ass_inv : forall Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ' κ A A', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ▹{κ} A ≈ Ψ' ▹{κ} A' -> ext_eq_ass_head Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ' κ A A'.
Proof.
  intros * H; inversion H; subst.
The sorts are found by the typings, so the choices backtrack.
  econstructor; multimatch goal with Hx : _ |- _ => exact Hx end.
Qed.

An annotated motive context T ▹ Z equal to T' ▹ Z' and to the motive's context T ▹ H: T ▹ Z' is equal to the motive's context too, the heads chained by wf_subtyp_trans.
Lemma ann_ctx_trans : forall Θ Ξ Δ T T' κ Z Z' H,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ˣ T ▹{κ} Z ≈ T' ▹{κ} Z' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ˣ T ▹{κ} Z ≈ T ▹{κ} H -> all_assumptions T ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ˣ T ▹{κ} Z' ≈ T ▹{κ} H.
Proof.
  intros * Ha Hb HT.
  destruct (ext_eq_ass_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ha) as [S1 HS1 S1' HS1' HTT' HZ HZ' HZZ' HZ'Z].
  destruct (ext_eq_ass_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hb) as [S2 HS2 S2' HS2' HTT _ HH HZH HHZ].
  pose proof (ctxsub_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ (ctxsub_ext_rev _ _ _ _ _ HTT' HT) HZ') as HZ'l.
  eapply wf_ext_eq_ass;
    [ exact HTT | exact HZ'l | exact HS1' | exact HH | exact HS2'
    | eapply wf_subtyp_trans; [ exact HZ'Z | exact HZH ]
    | eapply wf_subtyp_trans; [ exact HHZ | exact HZZ' ] ].
Qed.

The eliminator: the scrutinee, the motives, the annotations and the branches move under the equivalent substitutions lifted over their contexts, which the induction hypotheses of the telescope premises give; the annotations of the second side by the equations of the annotated contexts.
Lemma sub_eq_elim_case : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ' r p D Us m Mm Bks bm Ps M i,
    ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D ->
    ind_member D m = Some Mm ->
    List.nth_error Bks m = Some bm ->
    List.length Bks = ind_nblk D ->
    List.length Ps = im_np D Mm ->
    (forall k P T, List.nth_error Ps k = Some P -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_params D Mm) Id Ps) k = Some T ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ P : T) ->
    (forall k P T, List.nth_error Ps k = Some P -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_params D Mm) Id Ps) k = Some T ->
       forall Δ0 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ P[τ] ≈ P[τ'] : T[τ]) ->
    (forall Δ0 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ M[τ] ≈ M[τ'] : (ind_mty p D m (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps))[τ]) ->
    Us = List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> eb_binder_count b = S (im_nn Mk)) ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ▹{ak_relevant} eb_scrutinee_type b
                    ≈ elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       forall Δ0 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Γ ->
       (all_assumptions (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ▹{ak_relevant} eb_scrutinee_type b) ->
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ▹{ak_relevant} eb_scrutinee_type b) τ ++ Δ0
           ⊢ˢ sb_qn (List.length (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ▹{ak_relevant} eb_scrutinee_type b)) τ
            ≈ sb_qn (List.length (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ▹{ak_relevant} eb_scrutinee_type b)) τ'
           : (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ▹{ak_relevant} eb_scrutinee_type b) ++ Γ /\
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_sub (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ▹{ak_relevant} eb_scrutinee_type b) τ
           ≈ tele_sub (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ▹{ak_relevant} eb_scrutinee_type b) τ') /\
       (all_assumptions (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ ++ Δ0
           ⊢ˢ sb_qn (List.length (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))) τ
            ≈ sb_qn (List.length (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))) τ'
           : elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ /\
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_sub (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ
           ≈ tele_sub (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ')) ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ⊢ eb_motive b : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i) ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       forall Δ0 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ (eb_motive b)[τ] ≈ (eb_motive b)[τ'] : (abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i)[τ]) ->
    (forall k Mk, ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ≈ elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
    (forall k Mk, ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
       forall Δ0 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Γ ->
       (all_assumptions (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ ++ Δ0
           ⊢ˢ sb_qn (List.length (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))) τ
            ≈ sb_qn (List.length (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))) τ'
           : elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ /\
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_sub (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ
           ≈ tele_sub (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ') /\
       (all_assumptions (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ ++ Δ0
           ⊢ˢ sb_qn (List.length (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))) τ
            ≈ sb_qn (List.length (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))) τ'
           : elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ /\
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_sub (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ
           ≈ tele_sub (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ')) ->
    (forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> brs_names (im_cons Mk) (eb_brs b)) ->
    (forall k Mk c gs, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)
                    ≈ elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
    (forall k Mk c gs, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
       forall Δ0 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Γ ->
       (all_assumptions (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ ++ Δ0
           ⊢ˢ sb_qn (List.length (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))) τ
            ≈ sb_qn (List.length (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))) τ'
           : elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ /\
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_sub (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ
           ≈ tele_sub (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ') /\
       (all_assumptions (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ ++ Δ0
           ⊢ˢ sb_qn (List.length (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))) τ
            ≈ sb_qn (List.length (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))) τ'
           : elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ /\
         Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_sub (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ
           ≈ tele_sub (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) τ')) ->
    (forall k Mk b c gs n B, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       ind_con Mk c = Some gs -> List.In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) ->
       n = (im_nn Mk + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs)%nat) ->
    (forall k Mk b c gs n B, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       ind_con Mk c = Some gs -> List.In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ⊢ B
         : elim_branch_type p D k Mk c gs (eb_motive b) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ->
    (forall k Mk b c gs n B, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
       ind_con Mk c = Some gs -> List.In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) ->
       forall Δ0 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ B[τ] ≈ B[τ'] : (elim_branch_type p D k Mk c gs (eb_motive b) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))[τ]) ->
    motive_kind r ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ (a_elim r p Us m Bks M)[σ] ≈ (a_elim r p Us m Bks M)[σ']
      : ((eb_motive bm)[sb_of_list Id (List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps ++ M :: nil)])[σ].
Proof.
  intros * Hl HMm Hbm HlB HlP HPs IHPs IHM Hann Hnm HZ IHZ HA IHA HΨ IHΨ Hn HΨB IHΨB Hk HB IHB Hr Hσ.
  pose proof (type_sort_abs_kind r _ (type_sort_universe i)) as HS.
  pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hs; pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hs'.
  assert (HD : decl_closed D) by (eapply gctx_closed_ind; [ eapply wf_gctx_closed, (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hs) | exact Hl ]).
  assert (HUl : List.length (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) = ind_nu D) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; unfold im_np in HlP; lia).
  (* the premises at one substitution *)
  assert (HPs1 : forall k P T, List.nth_error Ps k = Some P -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_params D Mm) Id Ps) k = Some T ->
             forall Δ0 σ0, sub_as_sub Θ Ξ Δ0 σ0 Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ P[σ0] : T[σ0])
    by (intros; eapply sub_preserves_exp; eauto).
  assert (HZ1 : forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
             forall Δ0 σ0, sub_as_sub Θ Ξ Δ0 σ0 Γ ->
             Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_sub (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ▹{ak_relevant} eb_scrutinee_type b) σ0
                          ≈ tele_sub (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) σ0)
    by (intros; eapply sub_preserves_ext; eauto).
  assert (HA1 : forall k Mk b, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
             forall Δ0 σ0, sub_as_sub Θ Ξ Δ0 σ0 (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ) ->
             Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ (eb_motive b)[σ0] : (abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i)[σ0])
    by (intros; eapply sub_preserves_exp; eauto).
  assert (HΨ1 : forall k Mk, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> forall Δ0 σ0, sub_as_sub Θ Ξ Δ0 σ0 Γ ->
             Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_sub (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) σ0
                          ≈ tele_sub (elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) σ0)
    by (intros; eapply sub_preserves_ext; eauto).
  assert (HΨB1 : forall k Mk c gs, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
             forall Δ0 σ0, sub_as_sub Θ Ξ Δ0 σ0 Γ ->
             Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ˣ tele_sub (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) σ0
                          ≈ tele_sub (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) σ0)
    by (intros; eapply sub_preserves_ext; eauto).
  assert (HB1 : forall k Mk b c gs n B, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
             ind_con Mk c = Some gs -> List.In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) ->
             forall Δ0 σ0, sub_as_sub Θ Ξ Δ0 σ0 (elim_bctx r p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps) ++ Γ) ->
             Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ0 ⊢ B[σ0] : (elim_branch_type p D k Mk c gs (eb_motive b) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))[σ0])
    by (intros; eapply sub_preserves_exp; eauto).
  pose proof (sub_as_sub_dom Θ Ξ) as Rd; pose proof (sub_as_sub_ext Θ Ξ) as Re.
  rewrite !exp_sub_elim, (elim_type_sub D Mm bm) by eauto.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_elim_cong;
    [ exact Hl | exact HMm | rewrite nth_error_blocks_sub, Hbm; reflexivity
    | rewrite length_blocks_sub; exact HlB | rewrite length_blocks_sub; exact HlB | rewrite List.length_map; exact HlP | .. ].
  - eapply move_elim_params with (R := sub_as_sub Θ Ξ); eassumption.
  - rewrite List.length_map; exact HlP.
  - intros j0 P0 P0' T0 HP HP' HT; erewrite <- params_insts_sub in HT by eassumption.
    apply nth_error_map_inv in HP as (P & HP & ->); apply nth_error_map_inv in HP' as (P2 & HP' & ->).
    rewrite HP in HP'; injection HP' as <-; apply nth_error_map_inv in HT as (T & HT & ->).
    exact (IHPs _ _ _ HP HT _ _ _ Hσ).
  - rewrite <- ind_mty_split_sub by (try assumption; unfold im_np in HlP; lia); exact (IHM _ _ _ Hσ).
  - apply move_elim_ups; exact Hann.
  - apply move_elim_ups; exact Hann.
  - apply blocks_binder_count_ok_sub; exact Hnm.
  - apply blocks_binder_count_ok_sub; exact Hnm.
  - rewrite List.firstn_map; eapply move_blocks_ann with (R := sub_as_sub Θ Ξ); eassumption.
  - (* the annotations at the second substitution, at the parameters at the
       first: equal to those at the first *)
    intros k Mk b HMk Hb.
    rewrite nth_error_blocks_sub in Hb; destruct (List.nth_error Bks k) as [b0 |] eqn:Hb0; cbn in Hb; [| discriminate ].
    injection Hb as <-; destruct b0 as [nm Z0 A0 Bs0]; cbn [eblock_sub eb_scrutinee_type].
    pose proof (Hnm _ _ _ HMk Hb0) as Enm; cbn in Enm; subst nm.
    replace (S (im_nn Mk) - 1) with (im_nn Mk) by lia.
    assert (Hlft : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ˣ tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.map (fun U => U[σ]) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)))
                                  ▹{ak_relevant} Z0[sb_qn (im_nn Mk) σ]
                                ≈ elim_mctx p D k Mk (List.map (fun U => U[σ]) (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps))).
    { replace (Z0[sb_qn (im_nn Mk) σ]) with (eb_scrutinee_type (eblock_sub (eb_mk (S (im_nn Mk)) Z0 A0 Bs0) σ))
        by (cbn [eblock_sub eb_scrutinee_type]; replace (S (im_nn Mk) - 1) with (im_nn Mk) by lia; reflexivity).
      eapply move_blocks_ann with (R := sub_as_sub Θ Ξ) (k := k) (b := eblock_sub (eb_mk (S (im_nn Mk)) Z0 A0 Bs0) σ);
        first [ eassumption | rewrite nth_error_blocks_sub, Hb0; reflexivity ]. }
    assert (HtZ : all_assumptions (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk) (sb_of_list Id (List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps)) ▹{ak_relevant} Z0))
      by (constructor; [ eauto | apply all_assumptions_sub; eapply decl_closed_nparams_ass; eassumption ]).
    destruct (proj1 (IHZ _ _ _ HMk Hb0 _ _ _ Hσ) HtZ) as [_ HZσ].
    cbn [tele_sub centry_sub] in HZσ; rewrite length_tele_sub in HZσ; fold (im_nn Mk) in HZσ.
    erewrite !nparams_sub in HZσ by eassumption.
    rewrite List.firstn_map; unfold elim_mctx in Hlft |- *; eapply ann_ctx_trans; [ exact HZσ | exact Hlft |].
    apply all_assumptions_sub; eapply decl_closed_nparams_ass; eassumption.
  - rewrite List.firstn_map; eapply move_blocks_motive with (R := sub_as_sub Θ Ξ); eassumption.
  - (* the motives at the two substitutions *)
    intros k Mk b b' HMk Hb Hb'.
    rewrite !nth_error_blocks_sub in Hb, Hb'; destruct (List.nth_error Bks k) as [b0 |] eqn:Hb0; cbn in Hb, Hb'; [| discriminate ].
    injection Hb as <-; injection Hb' as <-.
    pose proof (Hnm _ _ _ HMk Hb0) as Enm; destruct b0 as [nm Z0 A0 Bs0]; cbn in Enm |- *; subst nm.
    destruct (proj1 (IHΨ _ _ HMk _ _ _ Hσ) (elim_mctx_ass _ _ _ _ _ HD HMk)) as [Hlift _].
    rewrite length_elim_mctx in Hlift; erewrite elim_mctx_sub in Hlift by eassumption.
    rewrite List.firstn_map; pose proof (IHA _ _ _ HMk Hb0 _ _ _ Hlift) as HAσ.
    rewrite type_sort_sub in HAσ by exact HS; exact HAσ.
  - intros k Mk HMk; rewrite List.firstn_map; erewrite <- elim_mctx_sub by eassumption; exact (HΨ1 _ _ HMk _ _ Hs).
  - apply move_blocks_names; exact Hn.
  - intros k b b' Hb Hb'; rewrite !nth_error_blocks_sub in Hb, Hb'.
    destruct (List.nth_error Bks k) as [[nm Z0 A0 Bs0] |]; cbn in Hb, Hb'; [| discriminate ].
    injection Hb as <-; injection Hb' as <-; cbn; unfold brs_sub; rewrite !brs_fst_map; reflexivity.
  - rewrite List.firstn_map; eapply move_blocks_bctx with (R := sub_as_sub Θ Ξ); eassumption.
  - apply move_blocks_counts; exact Hk.
  - (* the branches at the two substitutions *)
    intros k Mk b b' i0 c gs n B1 B2 HMk Hb Hb' Hi Hi' Hc.
    rewrite !nth_error_blocks_sub in Hb, Hb'; destruct (List.nth_error Bks k) as [b0 |] eqn:Hb0; cbn in Hb, Hb'; [| discriminate ].
    injection Hb as <-; injection Hb' as <-.
    pose proof (Hnm _ _ _ HMk Hb0) as Enm; destruct b0 as [nm Z0 A0 Bs0]; cbn in Enm, Hi, Hi' |- *; subst nm.
    unfold brs_sub in Hi, Hi'.
    apply nth_error_map_inv in Hi as ([[c1 n1] B] & Hi & Heq1); cbn in Heq1; injection Heq1 as -> -> ->.
    apply nth_error_map_inv in Hi' as ([[c2 n2] B'] & Hi' & Heq2); cbn in Heq2; injection Heq2 as -> -> ->.
    rewrite Hi in Hi'; injection Hi' as <-.
    pose proof (List.nth_error_In _ _ Hi) as Hin; cbn [eb_brs] in Hin.
    pose proof (Hk _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hb0 Hc Hin) as En; cbn in En; subst n2.
    destruct (proj1 (IHΨB _ _ _ _ HMk Hc _ _ _ Hσ) (elim_bctx_ass _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HD HMk)) as [Hlift _].
    rewrite length_elim_bctx in Hlift.
    erewrite elim_bctx_sub in Hlift;
      [| eassumption | eassumption | apply cons_lookup_in; eassumption | eassumption | intros j0 Mj HMj; eapply blocks_motives_sub; eassumption ].
    rewrite List.firstn_map; erewrite <- elim_branch_type_sub by eassumption.
    replace (im_nn Mk + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs) with (cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs + im_nn Mk) by lia.
    exact (IHB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hb0 Hc Hin _ _ _ Hlift).
  - exact Hr.
Qed.

The Module Cases of sub_eq_preserves_mut

Equivalent substitutions move each side of a judgment about units or module expressions to an equal one. A body unit's entries are compared with the entries before them filled in, in its parameters' context, so they are moved only under the lifting over the parameters, which are assumptions.

Lemma body_shape_dropn : forall n Φ Φ', body_shape Φ Φ' -> body_shape (gm_dropn n Φ) (gm_dropn n Φ').
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros [| Φ x E | Φ H its] [| Φ' x' E' | Φ' H' its'] Hs; cbn in Hs |- *; try contradiction; auto.
  apply IH, Hs.
Qed.

The opens of two bodies of the same shape, with expansions of the same shape, are paired: the expanded prefixes before them have the same shape.
Lemma body_opens_at_pair : forall Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx, body_xp Θ Ξ Γ Φ Φx ->
    forall Γ' Φ' Φx' k Φ0 H, body_xp Θ Ξ Γ' Φ' Φx' -> body_shape Φ Φ' -> body_shape Φx Φx' ->
    List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ Φx) k = Some (Φ0, H) ->
    exists Φ0' H', List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ' Φx') k = Some (Φ0', H') /\ body_shape Φ0 Φ0' /\ gm_nopens Φ0 = 0.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [| Γ Φ Φx x E Hx IH | Γ Φ Φx H0 its Φg R T gs Hx IH _ _ Hg _ _]; intros * Hx' Hs Hsx Hk.
  - destruct k; discriminate.
  - destruct Φ' as [| Φ1 x1 E1 | Φ1 Hm1 its1 Φg1]; cbn in Hs; try contradiction; destruct Hs as (Hs & _ & _).
    inversion Hx'; subst; cbn [body_opens_at gm_dropn] in Hk |- *.
    cbn in Hsx; destruct Hsx as (Hsx & _ & _); eauto.
  - destruct Φ' as [| Φ1 x1 E1 | Φ1 Hm1 its1 Φg1]; cbn in Hs; try contradiction; destruct Hs as (Hs & <- & _).
    inversion Hx'; subst.
    rewrite (body_opens_at_open _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg) in Hk.
    match goal with Hg' : items_gen _ _ _ _ its ?gs' |- _ =>
      rewrite (body_opens_at_open _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg');
      assert (Hl : List.length gs = List.length gs')
        by (rewrite (items_gen_length _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg), (items_gen_length _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg'); reflexivity);
      pose proof (body_shape_dropn (List.length gs) _ _ Hsx) as Hsx0;
      rewrite gm_dropn_gens_append in Hsx0; rewrite Hl, gm_dropn_gens_append in Hsx0 end.
    destruct k as [| k]; cbn in Hk |- *; [| eauto ].
    injection Hk as <- <-; do 2 eexists; split; [ reflexivity | split; [ exact Hsx0 | eapply body_xp_nopens; exact Hx ] ].
Qed.

Lemma sub_eq_ext_ass_diag : forall Θ Ξ Δ Ψ κ A Srt Γ0 σ σ',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Ψ σ ++ Γ0 ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Ψ) σ ≈ sb_qn (length Ψ) σ' : Ψ ++ Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˣ tele_sub Ψ σ ≈ tele_sub Ψ σ' ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Δ ⊢ A : Srt ->
    sort_kind Srt κ ->
    (forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Ψ ++ Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ A[τ] ≈ A[τ'] : Srt[τ]) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub (Ψ ▹{κ} A) σ ++ Γ0 ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length (Ψ ▹{κ} A)) σ ≈ sb_qn (length (Ψ ▹{κ} A)) σ' : Ψ ▹{κ} A ++ Δ /\
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˣ tele_sub (Ψ ▹{κ} A) σ ≈ tele_sub (Ψ ▹{κ} A) σ'.
Proof.
  intros * Hl HE HΨ HA HS IHA Hσ.
  pose proof (sort_kind_type_sort _ _ HS) as HS0.
  pose proof (IHA _ _ _ Hl) as HAσ; rewrite type_sort_sub in HAσ by exact HS0.
  split.
  - cbn [tele_sub List.length sb_qn List.app]; eapply wf_sub_eq_q; [ exact Hl | exact HA | exact HS | exact HAσ ].
  - cbn [tele_sub List.length].
    assert (Hr : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Ψ σ' ++ Γ0 ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Ψ) σ' : Ψ ++ Δ)
      by (apply wf_sub_ext; [ exact (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) | exact (ext_eq_ctx_right _ _ _ _ _ HE) | exact HΨ ]).
    eapply wf_ext_eq_ass_eq with (Srt := Srt).
    + exact HE.
    + exact (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA HS0 (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl)).
    + exact HS.
    + exact HAσ.
    + exact (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA HS0 (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl)).
    + exact (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA HS0 Hr).
Qed.

The parameters Δu of a unit, of the sorts Hps gives, given as the rule's premise HRp, moved by one substitution Hs into the context HΔ from the parameters' context HΓ: move_params_case at sub_as_sub, each parameter type moved by sub_preserves_exp.
Ltac sub_eq_params_case Hs HΓ HΔ Hps HRp :=
  eapply (move_params_case _ _ (sub_as_sub _ _) (sub_as_sub_ext _ _));
  [ exact Hs | exact HΓ | exact HΔ | exact Hps
  | let E := fresh "E" in let Hσ0 := fresh "Hσ0" in
    intros ? ? ? ? E ? ? Hσ0; exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HRp _ _ _ _ E) Hσ0) ].

The flag premise of an alias, a flatten or a body unit, moved by one substitution Hs: the level sorts and the description with no member of a type of levels move by sub_preserves_exp and sub_preserves_no_level.
Lemma sub_eq_levels_flag : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δu E (lv : bool) Rt Γ0 σ,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˢ σ : Γ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu ++ Γ -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Δu σ ++ Γ0 ->
    modexp_scoped (length (Δu ++ Γ)) E ->
    levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ Δu E lv Rt ->
    levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ0 (tele_sub Δu σ) E[sb_qn (length Δu) σ]ᵐ lv (mdesc_sub Rt (sb_qn (length Δu) σ)).
Proof.
  intros * Hs HΓ HΔ HE [Hf1 Hf2 Hf3].
  eapply sub_levels_flag; [ exact Hs | exact HΓ | exact HΔ | exact HE | exact Hf1 | exact Hf2 | ].
  intros Hlv * Hσ0; exact (sub_preserves_no_level _ _ _ _ _ _ (Hf3 Hlv) Hσ0).
Qed.

One side of a body unit, moved by two equivalent substitutions.
Lemma sub_eq_unit_self : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δu Φ Φx entry_sort l ps Γ0 σ σ',
    body_xp Θ Ξ (Δu ++ Γ) Φ Φx ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Δu σ ++ Γ0 ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Δu) σ ≈ sb_qn (length Δu) σ' : Δu ++ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˣ tele_sub Δu σ ≈ tele_sub Δu σ' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ body_ctx Φx ++ Δu ≈ body_ctx Φx ++ Δu ->
    (forall y, type_sort (entry_sort y)) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
       sort_kind (entry_sort y) (entry_kind E)) ->
    (forall k, parameter_sort l (ps k)) ->
    (forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, Δu = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ2 ++ Γ ⊢ T : ps (List.length Δ2)) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M σf, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) -> gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu ++ Γ ⊢ A[σf] : entry_sort y) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M σf, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) -> gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf ->
        forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δu ++ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ A[σf][τ] ≈ A[σf][τ'] : (entry_sort y)[τ]) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M σf, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) -> gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu ++ Γ ⊢ M[σf] : A[σf]) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M σf, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) -> gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf ->
        forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δu ++ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ M[σf][τ] ≈ M[σf][τ'] : A[σf][τ]) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E U σf, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_unit E = Some U -> gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu ++ Γ ⊢ᵘ U[σf]ᵘ ≈ U[σf]ᵘ) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E U σf, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_unit E = Some U -> gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf ->
        forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δu ++ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ᵘ U[σf]ᵘ[τ]ᵘ ≈ U[σf]ᵘ[τ']ᵘ) ->
    (forall k Ψ H, List.nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Δu ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H) ->
    (forall k Φ0 H σf, List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ Φx) k = Some (Φ0, H) -> gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf ->
        forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δu ++ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ᵐ H[σf]ᵐ[τ]ᵐ ≈ H[σf]ᵐ[τ']ᵐ) ->
    all_assumptions Δu -> body_shape Φ Φ -> body_shape Φx Φx -> List.NoDup (gm_names Φ) ->
    forall (lv : bool) Rt, levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ Δu (me_lit (gu_open nil Φ)) lv Rt ->
    (forall k Ψ H, List.nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Ψ ++ Δu ++ Γ) H) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_open Δu Φ ≈ gu_open Δu Φ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵘ (gu_open Δu Φ)[σ]ᵘ ≈ (gu_open Δu Φ)[σ']ᵘ.
Proof.
  intros * Hb Hσ L HΔσ Hx Hes Htg Hps HRp HA IHA HM IHM HU IHU Ho IHo Ha Hs Hsx Hn lv Rt Hf Hff HU0.
  pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hs0; pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hs1.
  assert (Hc : gctx_closed Θ Ξ) by (eapply wf_gctx_closed; eapply ext_eq_ctx_left; exact Hx).
  destruct (wf_unit_eq_scoped _ _ _ _ _ HU0) as (HΓs & HUs & _).
  rewrite gunit_scoped_mk in HUs; destruct HUs as [HΔs [_ HΦs]].
  pose proof (sub_preserves_ext _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hx Hs0) as Hxσ.
  pose proof (sub_preserves_ext _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hx Hs1) as Hxσ'.
  assert (HΔΓ : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu ++ Γ) by (pose proof (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ Hx) as HC; rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HC; eapply wf_ctx_app_tail; exact HC).
  assert (R : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Δu σ' ++ Γ0 ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Δu) σ' : Δu ++ Γ)
    by (apply wf_sub_ext; [ exact Hs1 | exact (ext_eq_ctx_right _ _ _ _ _ HΔσ) | exact HΔΓ ]).
  (* both prefixes of a self-pair are the same *)
  assert (Hsame : forall y X X', gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some X -> gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some X' -> X = X')
    by (intros * E1 E2; rewrite E1 in E2; injection E2 as ->; reflexivity).
  (* the flag premise, moved by either substitution *)
  pose proof (sub_eq_levels_flag _ _ _ _ (me_lit (gu_open nil Φ)) lv Rt _ _ Hs0 HΔΓ (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ HΔσ)
                ltac:(open_lit_scoped HΦs) Hf) as F.
  pose proof (sub_eq_levels_flag _ _ _ _ (me_lit (gu_open nil Φ)) lv Rt _ _ Hs1 HΔΓ (ext_eq_ctx_right _ _ _ _ _ HΔσ)
                ltac:(open_lit_scoped HΦs) Hf) as F'.
  eapply (unit_body_moved Θ Ξ Γ Δu Δu Φ Φ Φx Φx entry_sort l ps Γ0 σ σ');
    [ | | exact HΔσ | exact Hxσ | exact Hxσ' | | | | | | | | | | | exact Hb | exact Hb | exact Ha | exact Ha
    | reflexivity | exact Hs | exact Hsx | exact Hn | exact Hes | exact Htg | exact Htg | exact Hps | |
    | exact (levels_flag_sorted _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F) | exact (levels_flag_denotes _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F)
    | exact (levels_flag_no_level _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F)
    | exact (levels_flag_sorted _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F') | exact (levels_flag_denotes _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F')
    | exact (levels_flag_no_level _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F') ].
  (* the parameters, moved by either substitution *)
  all: try solve [ sub_eq_params_case Hs0 HΔΓ (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ HΔσ) Hps HRp
                 | sub_eq_params_case Hs1 HΔΓ (ext_eq_ctx_right _ _ _ _ _ HΔσ) Hps HRp ].
  - eapply body_xp_sub; [ exact Hc | exact Hb | apply ctx_scoped_app_iff; split; assumption | rewrite List.length_app; exact HΦs
                        | apply sub_mod_compat_ext; eauto using wf_sub_mod_compat ].
  - eapply body_xp_sub; [ exact Hc | exact Hb | apply ctx_scoped_app_iff; split; assumption | rewrite List.length_app; exact HΦs
                        | apply sub_mod_compat_ext; eauto using wf_sub_mod_compat ].
  - intros * Hp HE Hp' HE' Hf0 Hf0'.
    pose proof (Hsame _ _ _ Hp Hp') as Heq; injection Heq as <- <-; rewrite HE in HE'; injection HE' as <- <-.
    rewrite Hf0 in Hf0'; injection Hf0' as <-.
    pose proof (IHA _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp HE Hf0 _ _ _ L) as HAσ; rewrite type_sort_sub in HAσ by exact (Hes y).
    pose proof (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HA _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp HE Hf0) (Hes y) (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ L)) as HAl.
    split; [ exact HAl | split; [ exact HAσ | split ] ].
    + exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HM _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp HE Hf0) (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ L)).
    + exact (IHM _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp HE Hf0 _ _ _ L).
  - intros * Hp HE Hp' HE' Hf0 Hf0'.
    pose proof (Hsame _ _ _ Hp Hp') as Heq; injection Heq as <- <-; rewrite HE in HE'; injection HE' as <-.
    rewrite Hf0 in Hf0'; injection Hf0' as <-.
    exact (IHU _ _ _ _ _ Hp HE Hf0 _ _ _ L).
  - intros * Hp HE Hp' HE' Hf0 Hf0'.
    pose proof (Hsame _ _ _ Hp Hp') as Heq; injection Heq as <- <-; rewrite HE in HE'; injection HE' as <- <-.
    rewrite Hf0 in Hf0'; injection Hf0' as <-.
    split; [ exact (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HA _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp HE Hf0) (Hes y) R)
           | exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HM _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp HE Hf0) R) ].
  - intros * Hp HE Hp' HE' Hf0 Hf0'.
    pose proof (Hsame _ _ _ Hp Hp') as Heq; injection Heq as <- <-; rewrite HE in HE'; injection HE' as <-.
    rewrite Hf0 in Hf0'; injection Hf0' as <-.
    exact (sub_preserves_unit _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HU _ _ _ _ _ Hp HE Hf0) R).
  - intros k Ψ H Ek.
    destruct (body_opens_prefix _ _ _ _ _ Hb _ _ _ Ek) as [Ψr HΨr].
    assert (HΔ0 : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub (Ψ ++ Δu) σ ++ Γ0).
    { pose proof (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ Hxσ) as HC; rewrite HΨr, <- List.app_assoc, tele_sub_app, <- List.app_assoc in HC.
      eapply wf_ctx_app_tail; exact HC. }
    pose proof (wf_sub_ext _ _ (Ψ ++ Δu) _ _ _ Hs0 HΔ0 ltac:(rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact (presup_modexp_eq_ctx (Ho _ _ _ Ek)))) as Hσe.
    rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Hσe; exact (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (Ho _ _ _ Ek) Hσe).
  - intros k Ψ H Ek.
    destruct (body_opens_prefix _ _ _ _ _ Hb _ _ _ Ek) as [Ψr HΨr].
    assert (HΔ0 : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub (Ψ ++ Δu) σ' ++ Γ0).
    { pose proof (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ Hxσ') as HC; rewrite HΨr, <- List.app_assoc, tele_sub_app, <- List.app_assoc in HC.
      eapply wf_ctx_app_tail; exact HC. }
    pose proof (wf_sub_ext _ _ (Ψ ++ Δu) _ _ _ Hs1 HΔ0 ltac:(rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact (presup_modexp_eq_ctx (Ho _ _ _ Ek)))) as Hσe.
    rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Hσe; exact (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (Ho _ _ _ Ek) Hσe).
  (* the opens open no module still being defined, moved by either
     substitution *)
  - intros k Ψ H Ek.
    pose proof (Ho _ _ _ Ek) as HH0; pose proof (Hff _ _ _ Ek) as HF.
    destruct (wf_modexp_eq_scoped _ _ _ _ _ HH0) as (_ & HHs & _).
    pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH0) as HC.
    rewrite List.app_assoc in HF, HHs, HC.
    exact (sub_frame_free _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs0 HC HHs HF).
  - intros k Ψ H Ek.
    pose proof (Ho _ _ _ Ek) as HH0; pose proof (Hff _ _ _ Ek) as HF.
    destruct (wf_modexp_eq_scoped _ _ _ _ _ HH0) as (_ & HHs & _).
    pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH0) as HC.
    rewrite List.app_assoc in HF, HHs, HC.
    exact (sub_frame_free _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs1 HC HHs HF).
  - intros k Φ0 H Φ0' H' σf σf' Ek Ek' Hf0 Hf0'.
    rewrite Ek in Ek'; injection Ek' as <- <-; rewrite Hf0 in Hf0'; injection Hf0' as <-.
    exact (IHo _ _ _ _ Ek Hf0 _ _ _ L).
  - intros k Φ0 H Φ0' H' σf σf' Ek Ek' Hf0 Hf0'.
    rewrite Ek in Ek'; injection Ek' as <- <-; rewrite Hf0 in Hf0'; injection Hf0' as <-.
    pose proof (Ho _ _ _ (body_opens_at_nth _ _ _ _ _ Ek)) as HH0.
    pose proof (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH0 (wf_gm_fill _ _ _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH0) Hf0)) as HH1.
    exact (sub_preserves_modexp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH1 R).
Qed.

One side of an alias unit, moved by two equivalent substitutions: its target by its own moving, its parameters of the sorts ps gives, and its flag premise moved by each substitution (sub_eq_levels_flag).
Lemma sub_eq_unit_alias_self : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δu E l ps Γ0 σ σ',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Δu σ ++ Γ0 ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Δu) σ ≈ sb_qn (length Δu) σ' : Δu ++ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˣ tele_sub Δu σ ≈ tele_sub Δu σ' ->
    all_assumptions Δu ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E ->
    (forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δu ++ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ᵐ E[τ]ᵐ ≈ E[τ']ᵐ) ->
    (forall k, parameter_sort l (ps k)) ->
    (forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, Δu = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ2 ++ Γ ⊢ T : ps (List.length Δ2)) ->
    forall (lv : bool) Rt, levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ Δu E lv Rt ->
    frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Δu ++ Γ) E ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵘ (gu_mk Δu (md_alias E))[σ]ᵘ ≈ (gu_mk Δu (md_alias E))[σ']ᵘ.
Proof.
  intros * Hσ L HΔσ Ha HE IHE Hps HRp lv Rt Hf Hff.
  pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hs0; pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hs1.
  pose proof (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HE) as HΔΓ.
  destruct (wf_modexp_eq_scoped _ _ _ _ _ HE) as (_ & HsE & _).
  (* the flag premise, moved by either substitution *)
  pose proof (sub_eq_levels_flag _ _ _ _ _ lv Rt _ _ Hs0 HΔΓ (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ HΔσ) HsE Hf) as F.
  pose proof (sub_eq_levels_flag _ _ _ _ _ lv Rt _ _ Hs1 HΔΓ (ext_eq_ctx_right _ _ _ _ _ HΔσ) HsE Hf) as F'.
  rewrite !gunit_sub_mk; cbn [moddef_sub].
  eapply wf_unit_eq_alias with (param_level := l) (param_sorts := ps);
    [ exact HΔσ | apply all_assumptions_sub; exact Ha | apply all_assumptions_sub; exact Ha | exact (IHE _ _ _ L) | | exact Hps
    | sub_eq_params_case Hs0 HΔΓ (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ HΔσ) Hps HRp
    | sub_eq_params_case Hs1 HΔΓ (ext_eq_ctx_right _ _ _ _ _ HΔσ) Hps HRp
    | exact (levels_flag_sorted _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F) | exact (levels_flag_denotes _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F)
    | exact (levels_flag_no_level _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F)
    | exact (levels_flag_sorted _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F') | exact (levels_flag_denotes _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F')
    | exact (levels_flag_no_level _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F')
    | exact (sub_frame_free _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs0 HΔΓ HsE Hff)
    | exact (sub_frame_free _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs1 HΔΓ HsE Hff) ].
  eapply sub_preserves_modexp; [ exact HE |].
  apply wf_sub_ext; [ exact Hs1 | exact (ext_eq_ctx_right _ _ _ _ _ HΔσ) | exact HΔΓ ].
Qed.

Both sides of a flattened alias of a literal: the alias by congruence, the merged literal through the alias by flattening on either side.
Lemma sub_eq_unit_flatten_case : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ Δ' D l ps Γ0 σ σ',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Δ σ ++ Γ0 ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Δ) σ ≈ sb_qn (length Δ) σ' : Δ ++ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˣ tele_sub Δ σ ≈ tele_sub Δ σ' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Δ ≈ Δ ->
    all_assumptions Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_mk Δ' D ≈ gu_mk Δ' D ->
    (forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δ ++ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ᵘ (gu_mk Δ' D)[τ]ᵘ ≈ (gu_mk Δ' D)[τ']ᵘ) ->
    (forall k, parameter_sort l (ps k)) ->
    (forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, Δ = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ2 ++ Γ ⊢ T : ps (List.length Δ2)) ->
    forall (lv : bool) Rt, levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ Δ (me_lit (gu_mk Δ' D)) lv Rt ->
    frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) (me_lit (gu_mk Δ' D)) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵘ (gu_mk Δ (md_alias (me_lit (gu_mk Δ' D))))[σ]ᵘ ≈ (gu_mk Δ (md_alias (me_lit (gu_mk Δ' D))))[σ']ᵘ /\
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵘ (gu_mk (Δ' ++ Δ) D)[σ]ᵘ ≈ (gu_mk (Δ' ++ Δ) D)[σ']ᵘ.
Proof.
  intros * Hσ L HΔσ HΔ Ha HU IHU Hps HRp lv Rt Hf Hff.
  pose proof (presup_unit_eq_ctx HU) as HΔΓ.
  assert (HL : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵘ (gu_mk Δ (md_alias (me_lit (gu_mk Δ' D))))[σ]ᵘ ≈ (gu_mk Δ (md_alias (me_lit (gu_mk Δ' D))))[σ']ᵘ).
  { eapply sub_eq_unit_alias_self; [ exact Hσ | exact L | exact HΔσ | exact Ha | apply wf_me_lit; exact HU | | exact Hps | exact HRp
                                   | exact Hf | exact Hff ].
    intros * Hτ; cbn [modexp_sub]; apply wf_me_lit, IHU; exact Hτ. }
  split; [ exact HL |].
  assert (Hflat : forall s, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˢ s : Γ ->
             Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵘ (gu_mk Δ (md_alias (me_lit (gu_mk Δ' D))))[s]ᵘ ≈ (gu_mk (Δ' ++ Δ) D)[s]ᵘ).
  { intros s Hs.
    pose proof (sub_preserves_ext _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΔ Hs) as HΔs.
    pose proof (wf_sub_ext _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ HΔs) (presup_unit_eq_ctx HU)) as Hq.
    pose proof (sub_preserves_unit _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HU Hq) as HUs.
    change (gu_mk (Δ' ++ Δ) D) with (gunit_abs Δ (gu_mk Δ' D)); rewrite gunit_abs_sub, gunit_sub_mk; cbn [moddef_sub modexp_sub].
    destruct (wf_unit_eq_scoped _ _ _ _ _ HU) as (_ & HsU & _).
    pose proof (sub_eq_levels_flag _ _ _ _ (me_lit (gu_mk Δ' D)) lv Rt _ _ Hs HΔΓ (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ HΔs)
                  HsU Hf) as F.
    cbn [modexp_sub] in F.
    pose proof (sub_frame_free _ _ _ _ (me_lit (gu_mk Δ' D)) _ _ Hs HΔΓ HsU Hff) as FF; cbn [modexp_sub] in FF.
    revert HUs F FF; destruct ((gu_mk Δ' D)[sb_qn (length Δ) s]ᵘ) as [Δw Dw]; intros HUs F FF; cbn [gunit_abs].
    eapply wf_unit_eq_flatten with (param_level := l) (param_sorts := ps);
      [ exact HΔs | apply all_assumptions_sub; exact Ha | exact HUs | exact Hps
      | sub_eq_params_case Hs HΔΓ (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ HΔs) Hps HRp
      | exact (levels_flag_sorted _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F) | exact (levels_flag_denotes _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F)
      | exact (levels_flag_no_level _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F) | exact FF ]. }
  eapply wf_unit_eq_trans; [ apply wf_unit_eq_sym, Hflat, (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) |].
  eapply wf_unit_eq_trans; [ exact HL | apply Hflat, (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) ].
Qed.

Entries of the same shape both have a module part, or neither.
Lemma entry_shape_unit : forall E E' U, entry_shape E E' -> entry_unit E = Some U -> exists U', entry_unit E' = Some U'.
Proof.
  intros [? ? ? ? [] | | | | ] [? ? ? ? [] | | | | ] * HS HE; cbn in *; try contradiction; try discriminate; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma entry_shape_unit_r : forall E E' U', entry_shape E E' -> entry_unit E' = Some U' -> exists U, entry_unit E = Some U.
Proof.
  intros [? ? ? ? [] | | | | ] [? ? ? ? [] | | | | ] * HS HE; cbn in *; try contradiction; try discriminate; eauto.
Qed.

Both sides of a body unit, from the rule's premises.
Lemma sub_eq_unit_body_case : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δu Δu' Φ Φ' Φx Φx' entry_sort l ps Γ0 σ σ',
    body_xp Θ Ξ (Δu ++ Γ) Φ Φx ->
    body_xp Θ Ξ (Δu' ++ Γ) Φ' Φx' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Δu ≈ Δu' ->
    (forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Γ ->
       (all_assumptions Δu -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Δu τ ++ Γ1 ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Δu) τ ≈ sb_qn (length Δu) τ' : Δu ++ Γ /\
                        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˣ tele_sub Δu τ ≈ tele_sub Δu τ') /\
       (all_assumptions Δu' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Δu' τ ++ Γ1 ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Δu') τ ≈ sb_qn (length Δu') τ' : Δu' ++ Γ /\
                        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˣ tele_sub Δu' τ ≈ tele_sub Δu' τ')) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ body_ctx Φx ++ Δu ≈ body_ctx Φx ++ Δu ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ body_ctx Φx' ++ Δu' ≈ body_ctx Φx' ++ Δu' ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M Φ0' E' A' M' σf σf',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_tm E' = Some (A', M') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu ++ Γ ⊢ A[σf] : entry_sort y) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M Φ0' E' A' M' σf σf',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_tm E' = Some (A', M') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δu ++ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ A[σf][τ] ≈ A[σf][τ'] : (entry_sort y)[τ]) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M Φ0' E' A' M' σf σf',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_tm E' = Some (A', M') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu ++ Γ ⊢ A[σf] ≈ A'[σf'] : entry_sort y) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M Φ0' E' A' M' σf σf',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_tm E' = Some (A', M') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu ++ Γ ⊢ M[σf] : A[σf]) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M Φ0' E' A' M' σf σf',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_tm E' = Some (A', M') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δu ++ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ M[σf][τ] ≈ M[σf][τ'] : A[σf][τ]) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M Φ0' E' A' M' σf σf',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_tm E' = Some (A', M') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu ++ Γ ⊢ M[σf] ≈ M'[σf'] : A[σf]) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E U Φ0' E' U' σf σf',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_unit E = Some U ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_unit E' = Some U' ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu ++ Γ ⊢ᵘ U[σf]ᵘ ≈ U'[σf']ᵘ) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E U Φ0' E' U' σf σf',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_unit E = Some U ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_unit E' = Some U' ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δu ++ Γ ->
          Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ᵘ U[σf]ᵘ[τ]ᵘ ≈ U[σf]ᵘ[τ']ᵘ /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ᵘ U'[σf']ᵘ[τ]ᵘ ≈ U'[σf']ᵘ[τ']ᵘ) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M Φ0' E' A' M' σf σf',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_tm E' = Some (A', M') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu' ++ Γ ⊢ A'[σf'] : entry_sort y) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M Φ0' E' A' M' σf σf',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_tm E' = Some (A', M') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δu' ++ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ A'[σf'][τ] ≈ A'[σf'][τ'] : (entry_sort y)[τ]) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M Φ0' E' A' M' σf σf',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_tm E' = Some (A', M') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu' ++ Γ ⊢ M'[σf'] : A'[σf']) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M Φ0' E' A' M' σf σf',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_tm E' = Some (A', M') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δu' ++ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ M'[σf'][τ] ≈ M'[σf'][τ'] : A'[σf'][τ]) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E U Φ0' E' U' σf σf',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_unit E = Some U ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_unit E' = Some U' ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu' ++ Γ ⊢ᵘ U'[σf']ᵘ ≈ U'[σf']ᵘ) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E U Φ0' E' U' σf σf',
        gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_unit E = Some U ->
        gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_unit E' = Some U' ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δu' ++ Γ ->
          Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ᵘ U'[σf']ᵘ[τ]ᵘ ≈ U'[σf']ᵘ[τ']ᵘ /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ᵘ U'[σf']ᵘ[τ]ᵘ ≈ U'[σf']ᵘ[τ']ᵘ) ->
    (forall k Ψ H, List.nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ ++ Δu ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H) ->
    (forall k Ψ' H', List.nth_error (body_opens Φ' Φx') k = Some (Ψ', H') -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Ψ' ++ Δu' ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ H' ≈ H') ->
    (forall k Ψ H, List.nth_error (body_opens Φ Φx) k = Some (Ψ, H) -> frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Ψ ++ Δu ++ Γ) H) ->
    (forall k Ψ' H', List.nth_error (body_opens Φ' Φx') k = Some (Ψ', H') -> frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Ψ' ++ Δu' ++ Γ) H') ->
    (forall k Φ0 H Φ0' H' σf σf',
        List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ Φx) k = Some (Φ0, H) -> List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ' Φx') k = Some (Φ0', H') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ H[σf]ᵐ ≈ H'[σf']ᵐ) ->
    (forall k Φ0 H Φ0' H' σf σf',
        List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ Φx) k = Some (Φ0, H) -> List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ' Φx') k = Some (Φ0', H') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δu ++ Γ ->
          Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ᵐ H[σf]ᵐ[τ]ᵐ ≈ H[σf]ᵐ[τ']ᵐ /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ᵐ H'[σf']ᵐ[τ]ᵐ ≈ H'[σf']ᵐ[τ']ᵐ) ->
    (forall k Φ0 H Φ0' H' σf σf',
        List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ Φx) k = Some (Φ0, H) -> List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ' Φx') k = Some (Φ0', H') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu' ++ Γ ⊢ᵐ H'[σf']ᵐ ≈ H'[σf']ᵐ) ->
    (forall k Φ0 H Φ0' H' σf σf',
        List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ Φx) k = Some (Φ0, H) -> List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ' Φx') k = Some (Φ0', H') ->
        gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
        forall Γ1 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δu' ++ Γ ->
          Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ᵐ H'[σf']ᵐ[τ]ᵐ ≈ H'[σf']ᵐ[τ']ᵐ /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ1 ⊢ᵐ H'[σf']ᵐ[τ]ᵐ ≈ H'[σf']ᵐ[τ']ᵐ) ->
    all_assumptions Δu -> all_assumptions Δu' -> length Δu = length Δu' ->
    body_shape Φ Φ' -> body_shape Φx Φx' -> List.NoDup (gm_names Φ) ->
    (forall y, type_sort (entry_sort y)) ->
    (forall y Φ0 E A M, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) -> entry_tm E = Some (A, M) ->
       sort_kind (entry_sort y) (entry_kind E)) ->
    (forall y Φ0' E' A' M', gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') -> entry_tm E' = Some (A', M') ->
       sort_kind (entry_sort y) (entry_kind E')) ->
    (forall k, parameter_sort l (ps k)) ->
    (forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, Δu = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ2 ++ Γ ⊢ T : ps (List.length Δ2)) ->
    (forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, Δu' = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ2 ++ Γ ⊢ T : ps (List.length Δ2)) ->
    forall (lv lv' : bool) Rt Rt',
    levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ Δu (me_lit (gu_open nil Φ)) lv Rt ->
    levels_flag Θ Ξ Γ Δu' (me_lit (gu_open nil Φ')) lv' Rt' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵘ (gu_open Δu Φ)[σ]ᵘ ≈ (gu_open Δu Φ)[σ']ᵘ /\
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵘ (gu_open Δu' Φ')[σ]ᵘ ≈ (gu_open Δu' Φ')[σ']ᵘ.
Proof.
  intros * Hb Hb' HΔ IHΔ Hx Hx' HA IHA HAA HM IHM HMM HU IHU HAr IHAr HMr IHMr HUr IHUr Ho Ho' Hff Hff' HOO IHOO HOR IHOR
           Ha Ha' Hl Hs Hsx Hn Hes Htg Htg' Hps HRp HRp' lv lv' Rt Rt' HFl HFr Hσ.
  (* an open of one side has its counterpart on the other, filled in *)
  assert (Hopair : forall k Φ0 H σf, List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ Φx) k = Some (Φ0, H) -> gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf ->
            exists Φ0' H' σf', List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ' Φx') k = Some (Φ0', H') /\ gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf').
  { intros * Ek Hf0; destruct (body_opens_at_pair _ _ _ _ _ Hb _ _ _ _ _ _ Hb' Hs Hsx Ek) as (Φ0' & H' & Ek' & Hs0 & Hn0).
    destruct (body_shape_fill _ _ Hn0 Hs0) as [_ Hf0'].
    destruct (gm_fill Φ0') as [σf' |] eqn:E'; [ do 3 eexists; split; [ exact Ek' | exact E' ] | contradiction ]. }
  assert (Hopair' : forall k Φ0' H' σf', List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ' Φx') k = Some (Φ0', H') -> gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf' ->
            exists Φ0 H σf, List.nth_error (body_opens_at Φ Φx) k = Some (Φ0, H) /\ gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf).
  { intros * Ek' Hf0'.
    destruct (body_opens_at_pair _ _ _ _ _ Hb' _ _ _ _ _ _ Hb (body_shape_sym _ _ Hs) (body_shape_sym _ _ Hsx) Ek')
      as (Φ0 & H & Ek & Hs0 & Hn0).
    destruct (body_shape_fill _ _ Hn0 Hs0) as [_ Hf0].
    destruct (gm_fill Φ0) as [σf |] eqn:E; [ do 3 eexists; split; [ exact Ek | exact E ] | contradiction ]. }
  destruct (body_shape_fill _ _ (body_xp_nopens _ _ _ _ _ Hb) Hsx) as [Hf Hf'].
  destruct (IHΔ _ _ _ Hσ) as [HL HR].
  destruct (HL Ha) as [L HΔσ]; destruct (HR Ha') as [L' HΔσ'].
  destruct (body_shape_refl _ _ Hsx) as (Hsx1 & Hsx2 & Hnx).
  pose proof (body_shape_of_xp _ _ _ _ _ Hb Hsx1) as Hs1.
  pose proof (body_shape_of_xp _ _ _ _ _ Hb' Hsx2) as Hs2.
  assert (Hnames : gm_names Φ = gm_names Φ')
    by (rewrite <- (body_xp_names _ _ _ _ _ Hb), <- (body_xp_names _ _ _ _ _ Hb'); exact Hnx).
  (* a definition or a module of one side has its counterpart on the other *)
  assert (Hpair : forall y Φ0 E, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) ->
            exists Φ0' E' σf', gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') /\ entry_shape E E' /\ gm_fill Φ0' = Some σf').
  { intros * Hp; destruct (shape_prefix _ _ _ _ _ Hsx Hp) as (Φ0' & E' & Hp' & _ & HE).
    destruct (fill_prefix _ _ _ _ Hf' Hp') as (σf' & Hf0'); eauto 6. }
  assert (Hpair' : forall y Φ0' E', gm_prefix_upto Φx' y = Some (gm_ext Φ0' y E') ->
            exists Φ0 E σf, gm_prefix_upto Φx y = Some (gm_ext Φ0 y E) /\ entry_shape E E' /\ gm_fill Φ0 = Some σf).
  { intros * Hp'; destruct (shape_prefix _ _ _ _ _ (body_shape_sym _ _ Hsx) Hp') as (Φ0 & E & Hp & _ & HE).
    destruct (fill_prefix _ _ _ _ Hf Hp) as (σf & Hf0).
    destruct E' as [? ? ? ? [] | | | | ], E as [? ? ? ? [] | | | | ]; cbn in HE; try contradiction; do 3 eexists;
      (split; [ exact Hp | split; [| exact Hf0 ] ]); cbn; intuition. }
  assert (HU0 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_open Δu Φ ≈ gu_open Δu' Φ')
    by (eapply wf_unit_eq_body;
        first [ eassumption
              | exact (levels_flag_sorted _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HFl) | exact (levels_flag_denotes _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HFl)
              | exact (levels_flag_no_level _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HFl) | exact (levels_flag_sorted _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HFr)
              | exact (levels_flag_denotes _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HFr) | exact (levels_flag_no_level _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HFr) ]).
  split.
  - eapply sub_eq_unit_self; [ exact Hb | exact Hσ | exact L | exact HΔσ | exact Hx | exact Hes | exact Htg | exact Hps
                             | exact HRp | | | | | | | exact Ho |
                             | exact Ha | exact Hs1 | exact Hsx1 | exact Hn | exact HFl | exact Hff
                             | eapply wf_unit_eq_trans; [ exact HU0 | apply wf_unit_eq_sym; exact HU0 ] ].
    7: intros k Φ0 H σf Ek Hf0; destruct (Hopair _ _ _ _ Ek Hf0) as (Φ0' & H' & σf' & Ek' & Hf0');
         intros; eapply proj1; eapply IHOO; eassumption.
    + intros y Φ0 E A M σf Hp HE Hf0; destruct (Hpair _ _ _ Hp) as (Φ0' & E' & σf' & Hp' & HS & Hf0');
        destruct (entry_shape_tm _ _ _ _ HS HE) as (A' & M' & HE'); eapply HA; eassumption.
    + intros y Φ0 E A M σf Hp HE Hf0; destruct (Hpair _ _ _ Hp) as (Φ0' & E' & σf' & Hp' & HS & Hf0');
        destruct (entry_shape_tm _ _ _ _ HS HE) as (A' & M' & HE'); eapply IHA; eassumption.
    + intros y Φ0 E A M σf Hp HE Hf0; destruct (Hpair _ _ _ Hp) as (Φ0' & E' & σf' & Hp' & HS & Hf0');
        destruct (entry_shape_tm _ _ _ _ HS HE) as (A' & M' & HE'); eapply HM; eassumption.
    + intros y Φ0 E A M σf Hp HE Hf0; destruct (Hpair _ _ _ Hp) as (Φ0' & E' & σf' & Hp' & HS & Hf0');
        destruct (entry_shape_tm _ _ _ _ HS HE) as (A' & M' & HE'); eapply IHM; eassumption.
    + intros y Φ0 E U σf Hp HE Hf0; destruct (Hpair _ _ _ Hp) as (Φ0' & E' & σf' & Hp' & HS & Hf0');
        destruct (entry_shape_unit _ _ _ HS HE) as (U' & HE');
        eapply wf_unit_eq_trans; [ eapply HU; eassumption | apply wf_unit_eq_sym; eapply HU; eassumption ].
    + intros y Φ0 E U σf Hp HE Hf0; destruct (Hpair _ _ _ Hp) as (Φ0' & E' & σf' & Hp' & HS & Hf0');
        destruct (entry_shape_unit _ _ _ HS HE) as (U' & HE'); intros; eapply proj1; eapply IHU; eassumption.
  - eapply sub_eq_unit_self; [ exact Hb' | exact Hσ | exact L' | exact HΔσ' | exact Hx' | exact Hes | exact Htg'
                             | exact Hps | exact HRp' | | | | | | | exact Ho' |
                             | exact Ha' | exact Hs2 | exact Hsx2 | rewrite <- Hnames; exact Hn | exact HFr | exact Hff'
                             | eapply wf_unit_eq_trans; [ apply wf_unit_eq_sym; exact HU0 | exact HU0 ] ].
    7: intros k Φ0' H' σf' Ek' Hf0'; destruct (Hopair' _ _ _ _ Ek' Hf0') as (Φ0 & H & σf & Ek & Hf0);
         intros; eapply proj1; eapply IHOR; [ exact Ek | exact Ek' | exact Hf0 | exact Hf0' | eassumption ].
    + intros y Φ0' E' A' M' σf' Hp' HE' Hf0'; destruct (Hpair' _ _ _ Hp') as (Φ0 & E & σf & Hp & HS & Hf0);
        destruct (entry_shape_tm_r _ _ _ _ HS HE') as (A & M & HE); eapply HAr; eassumption.
    + intros y Φ0' E' A' M' σf' Hp' HE' Hf0'; destruct (Hpair' _ _ _ Hp') as (Φ0 & E & σf & Hp & HS & Hf0);
        destruct (entry_shape_tm_r _ _ _ _ HS HE') as (A & M & HE); eapply IHAr; eassumption.
    + intros y Φ0' E' A' M' σf' Hp' HE' Hf0'; destruct (Hpair' _ _ _ Hp') as (Φ0 & E & σf & Hp & HS & Hf0);
        destruct (entry_shape_tm_r _ _ _ _ HS HE') as (A & M & HE); eapply HMr; eassumption.
    + intros y Φ0' E' A' M' σf' Hp' HE' Hf0'; destruct (Hpair' _ _ _ Hp') as (Φ0 & E & σf & Hp & HS & Hf0);
        destruct (entry_shape_tm_r _ _ _ _ HS HE') as (A & M & HE); eapply IHMr; eassumption.
    + intros y Φ0' E' U' σf' Hp' HE' Hf0'; destruct (Hpair' _ _ _ Hp') as (Φ0 & E & σf & Hp & HS & Hf0);
        destruct (entry_shape_unit_r _ _ _ HS HE') as (U & HE); eapply HUr; eassumption.
    + intros y Φ0' E' U' σf' Hp' HE' Hf0'; destruct (Hpair' _ _ _ Hp') as (Φ0 & E & σf & Hp & HS & Hf0);
        destruct (entry_shape_unit_r _ _ _ HS HE') as (U & HE); intros; eapply proj1; eapply IHUr; eassumption.
Qed.

The parameters of a unit are of evaluated kinds: types of a universe or types of levels. Every rule of the unit judgment requires it of its sides.
Definition unit_params_evaluated (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) (U : gunit) : Prop :=
  exists l, params_evaluated Θ Ξ Γ (gu_params U) l.

Both sides of an equation of units have parameters of evaluated kinds.
Lemma unit_eq_params_evaluated : forall Θ Ξ Γ U U', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' ->
    unit_params_evaluated Θ Ξ Γ U /\ unit_params_evaluated Θ Ξ Γ U'.
Proof.
  intros * H; induction H; unfold unit_params_evaluated in *; cbn [gu_params] in *;
    try solve [ split; eexists; eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption | tauto ].
  (* the flattened literal: the outer parameters by the premise, the inner
     ones by the literal's *)
  assert (HR : params_evaluated Θ Ξ Γ Δ param_level) by (eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption).
  split; [ eexists; exact HR |].
  match goal with IH : _ /\ exists l', params_evaluated _ _ _ _ l' |- _ =>
    let lw := fresh "lw" in let Hlw := fresh "Hlw" in destruct IH as [_ [lw Hlw]];
    exists (max lw param_level); apply params_evaluated_app; assumption end.
Qed.

A literal given its outermost parameter, both sides moved.
Lemma lit_app_cong : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ1 κ1 X1 D1 Δ2 κ2 X2 D2 N1 N2,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_mk (Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ1 X1 :: nil) D1 ≈ gu_mk (Δ2 ++ ce_ass κ2 X2 :: nil) D2 ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N1 : X1 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N1 ≈ N2 : X1 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ N2 : X2 ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ me_app (me_lit (gu_mk (Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ1 X1 :: nil) D1)) N1 ≈ me_app (me_lit (gu_mk (Δ2 ++ ce_ass κ2 X2 :: nil) D2)) N2.
Proof.
  intros * HU HN1 HN HN2.
  pose proof (gctx_valid_syn _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_unit_eq_ctx HU))) as Hv.
  pose proof (wf_me_lit _ _ _ _ _ HU) as HH.
  destruct (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 denote_exists)))))) _ _ _ _ _ HH) as (_ & (R1 & _ & HR1 & _) & (R2 & _ & HR2 & _)).
  destruct (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 desc_typed)))))) _ _ _ _ _ HH Hv) as (_ & HK1 & HK2).
  assert (Ht : forall Δ κ X D R, mdenote Θ Ξ Γ (me_lit (gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D)) R -> desc_ok Θ Ξ Γ R ->
            exists T1, mdesc_mod_tele R = Some (T1 ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil)).
  { intros * Hm Hok; inversion Hm; subst; try (unfold gc_unit in *; cbn in *; discriminate).
    match goal with Hu : udenote _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
      destruct (udenote_last _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hu) as (R0 & Hu0 & ->);
      exact (desc_ok_mtele_last _ _ _ _ _ _ (udenote_is_mod _ _ _ _ _ _ Hu0) Hok) end. }
  destruct (Ht _ _ _ _ _ HR1 (HK1 _ HR1)) as (T1 & HT1).
  destruct (Ht _ _ _ _ _ HR2 (HK2 _ HR2)) as (T2 & HT2).
  destruct (unit_eq_params_evaluated _ _ _ _ _ HU) as [[i HX1] [j HX2]]; cbn [gu_params] in HX1, HX2.
  specialize (HX1 _ _ _ _ eq_refl); specialize (HX2 _ _ _ _ eq_refl); cbn [List.app] in HX1, HX2.
  (* each argument type is of a universe or of the types of levels *)
  destruct HX1 as [HX1 | HX1], HX2 as [HX2 | HX2].
  all: eapply wf_me_app; [ exact HH | exact HR1 | exact HT1 | apply tele_view_last | exact HX1 | | exact HN1 | exact HN
                      | exact HR2 | exact HT2 | apply tele_view_last | exact HX2 | | exact HN2 ]; constructor.
Qed.

The record cases of sub_eq_preserves_mut. The type former is closed, so both sides are the same term at its closed type.
Lemma sub_eq_record_case : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ' p R i,
    record_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some R ->
    List.NoDup (List.map fst (record_fields R)) ->
    all_assumptions (record_params R) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅ ⊢ record_ty R : Typeω@i ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ record_fctx R (List.length (record_fields R)) ++ record_params R ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ record_params R ⊢ᵤ record_sort R ->
    (forall k f T, List.nth_error (record_fields R) k = Some (f, T) ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ record_fctx R k ++ record_params R ⊢ T : abs_kind_sort (record_field_kind R k) (record_sort R)[wk_shiftn k]ʷ) ->
    List.length (record_field_kinds R) = List.length (record_fields R) ->
    (forall k, field_kind (record_field_kind R k)) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ (a_record p)[σ] ≈ (a_record p)[σ'] : (record_ty R)[σ].
Proof.
  intros * Hl Hnd Hass Hty Hc Hs Hf Hrl Hfk Hσ.
  pose proof (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ)) as HΓ.
  rewrite record_ty_sub by (eapply wf_record_closed; [ exact HΓ | exact Hl ]).
  cbn [exp_sub]; eapply wf_exp_eq_record_cong; eassumption.
Qed.

A tuple: field by field, at the moved parameters.
Lemma sub_eq_tuple_case : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ' T p Ns R fs i,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ T : Typeω@i ->
    (forall Γ0 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ T[τ] ≈ T[τ'] : Typeω@i[τ]) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ T ≈ apps_exp (a_record p) Ns : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ a_record p : record_ty R ->
    record_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some R ->
    List.length Ns = List.length (record_params R) ->
    (forall k N A, List.nth_error Ns k = Some N -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (record_params R) Id Ns) k = Some A ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ N : A) ->
    List.map fst fs = List.map fst (record_fields R) ->
    (forall k f M U, List.nth_error fs k = Some (f, M) -> List.nth_error (record_fields R) k = Some (f, U) ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ M : U[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ List.firstn k (List.map snd fs))]) ->
    (forall k f M U, List.nth_error fs k = Some (f, M) -> List.nth_error (record_fields R) k = Some (f, U) ->
       forall Γ0 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ M[τ] ≈ M[τ'] : U[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ List.firstn k (List.map snd fs))][τ]) ->
