    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ (a_tuple T fs)[σ] ≈ (a_tuple T fs)[σ'] : T[σ].
Proof.
  intros * HT IHT HTeq Hr Hl Hn HN Hnames Hf IHf Hσ.
  pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hs; pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hs'.
  assert (Ht : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ a_tuple T fs : T) by (eapply wf_tuple; eassumption).
  pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ht Hs) as Htl.
  pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ht Hs') as Htr.
  pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HT Hs) as HTl.
  pose proof (IHT _ _ _ Hσ) as ET.
  assert (HRd : record_closed R) by (eapply wf_record_closed; [ exact (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hs) | exact Hl ]).
  cbn [exp_sub] in Htl, Htr, HTl, ET |- *.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_tuple_cong with (Ns := List.map (fun N => N[σ]) Ns).
  - exact Htl.
  - exact ET.
  - pose proof (sub_preserves_exp_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HTeq Hs) as H; rewrite apps_exp_sub in H; exact H.
  - exact Hl.
  - rewrite List.length_map; exact Hn.
  - intros j N' A' HN' HA'.
    rewrite <- record_params_insts_sub in HA' by exact HRd.
    apply nth_error_map_inv in HN' as (N & HN0 & ->); apply nth_error_map_inv in HA' as (A & HA0 & ->).
    exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HN _ _ _ HN0 HA0) Hs).
  - rewrite tuple_names_sub; exact Hnames.
  - rewrite !tuple_names_sub; reflexivity.
  - intros k f M0 M0' U HM0 HM0' HU.
    apply nth_error_map_inv in HM0 as ([f0 M] & HM & [= -> ->]).
    apply nth_error_map_inv in HM0' as ([f1 M'] & HM' & [= -> ->]); cbn.
    rewrite HM in HM'; injection HM' as <-.
    pose proof (IHf _ _ _ _ HM HU _ _ _ Hσ) as H.
    rewrite (record_field_sub _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRd HU Hn) in H.
    + rewrite tuple_values_sub in H; exact H.
    + rewrite List.length_firstn, List.length_map; pose proof (nth_error_lt_length _ _ _ HM); lia.
  - eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [ exact Htr | exact HTl | constructor
                          | eapply wf_subtyp_refl; [ exact HTl | constructor | apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact ET ] ].
Qed.

A projection: its own congruence, at the moved scrutinee.
Lemma sub_eq_proj_case : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ' M p Ns R k f U Srt,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ M : apps_exp (a_record p) Ns ->
    (forall Γ0 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ M[τ] ≈ M[τ'] : (apps_exp (a_record p) Ns)[τ]) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ a_record p : record_ty R ->
    record_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some R ->
    List.length Ns = List.length (record_params R) ->
    (forall k N A, List.nth_error Ns k = Some N -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (record_params R) Id Ns) k = Some A ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ N : A) ->
    List.nth_error (record_fields R) k = Some (f, U) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ U[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ record_pre R k M)] : Srt ->
    (forall Γ0 τ τ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Δ ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ U[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ record_pre R k M)][τ] ≈ U[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ record_pre R k M)][τ'] : Srt[τ]) ->
    type_sort Srt ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ (a_proj f M)[σ] ≈ (a_proj f M)[σ'] : U[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ record_pre R k M)][σ].
Proof.
  intros * HM IHM Hr Hl Hn HN Hk HU IHU HS Hσ.
  pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hs; pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hs'.
  assert (HRd : record_closed R) by (eapply wf_record_closed; [ exact (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hs) | exact Hl ]).
  assert (HL : List.length (record_pre R k M) = k)
    by (apply length_record_pre; pose proof (nth_error_lt_length _ _ _ Hk); lia).
  assert (Hp : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ a_proj f M : U[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ record_pre R k M)]) by (eapply wf_proj; eassumption).
  pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hp Hs') as Hpr.
  pose proof (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HU HS Hs) as HUl.
  pose proof (IHU _ _ _ Hσ) as EU; rewrite type_sort_sub in EU by exact HS.
  assert (Hpr' : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ (a_proj f M)[σ'] : U[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ record_pre R k M)][σ])
    by (eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [ exact Hpr | exact HUl | exact HS
                              | eapply wf_subtyp_refl; [ exact HUl | exact HS | apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact EU ] ]).
  pose proof (IHM _ _ _ Hσ) as EM; rewrite apps_exp_sub in EM.
  pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr Hs) as Hrσ; rewrite record_ty_sub in Hrσ by exact HRd.
  rewrite (record_field_sub _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRd Hk Hn HL), record_pre_sub in HUl, Hpr' |- *.
  cbn [exp_sub] in Hpr' |- *.
  eapply wf_exp_eq_proj_cong; [ exact EM | exact Hrσ | exact Hl | rewrite List.length_map; exact Hn | | exact Hk | exact HUl
                              | exact HS | exact Hpr' ].
  intros j N' A' HN' HA'.
  rewrite <- record_params_insts_sub in HA' by exact HRd.
  apply nth_error_map_inv in HN' as (N & HN0 & ->); apply nth_error_map_inv in HA' as (A & HA0 & ->).
  exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (HN _ _ _ HN0 HA0) Hs).
Qed.

The local-module case of sub_eq_preserves_mut, at a body's type of either sort: both sides are reduced by ζ and meet at the body under the two extended substitutions, at the body's type.
Ltac sub_eq_let_mod_case :=
  match goal with
  | Hσ : wf_sub_eq ?Θ ?Ξ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ ?σ', HU : wf_unit_eq _ _ ?Γ ?U ?U,
    HC : wf_exp _ _ (ce_mod ?U :: ?Γ) ?S ?C, HB : wf_exp _ _ (ce_mod ?U :: ?Γ) ?C ?B,
    Hl : wf_sub _ _ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ, Hr : wf_sub _ _ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ',
    IHC : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ (ce_mod ?U :: ?Γ) _ _ -> wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?C _) _,
    IHB : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ (ce_mod ?U :: ?Γ) _ _ -> wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?B _) _,
    IHU : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub ?U _) (gunit_sub ?U _) /\ _ |- _ =>
      let HS := fresh "HS" in let Hτ := fresh "Hτ" in let HUl := fresh "HUl" in let HUr := fresh "HUr" in
      let Hz := fresh "Hz" in let HCτ := fresh "HCτ" in
      assert (HS : type_sort S) by constructor;
      pose proof (wf_sub_eq_extend_mod _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ HU (proj1 (IHU _ _ _ Hσ))) as Hτ;
      assert (HUl : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵘ U[σ]ᵘ ≈ U[σ]ᵘ) by (eapply sub_preserves_unit; eassumption);
      assert (HUr : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵘ U[σ']ᵘ ≈ U[σ']ᵘ) by (eapply sub_preserves_unit; eassumption);
      assert (Hz : forall s, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˢ s : Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ᵘ U[s]ᵘ ≈ U[s]ᵘ ->
                     Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ ℓₘ U[s]ᵘ in B[q s] ≈ B[s ,,ₘ me_lit U[s]ᵘ] : C[s ,,ₘ me_lit U[s]ᵘ])
        by (let s := fresh "s" in let Hs := fresh "Hs" in let HUs := fresh "HUs" in
            intros s Hs HUs; rewrite <- (exp_sub_q_extend_mod B), <- (exp_sub_q_extend_mod C);
            eapply wf_exp_eq_let_mod_zeta;
            [ exact HUs
            | eapply sub_preserves_sort; [ exact HC | exact HS | apply wf_sub_q_mod; assumption ]
            | exact HS
            | constructor
            | eapply sub_preserves_exp; [ exact HB | apply wf_sub_q_mod; assumption ] ]);
      rewrite exp_sub_extend_mod_sub;
      pose proof (IHC _ _ _ Hτ) as HCτ; try rewrite (type_sort_sub S _) in HCτ by exact HS;
      eapply wf_exp_eq_meet;
        [ exact (Hz _ Hl HUl) | exact (IHB _ _ _ Hτ) | exact (Hz _ Hr HUr)
        | eapply sub_preserves_sort; [ exact HC | exact HS | eapply wf_sub_eq_left; exact Hτ ]
        | exact HS | exact HCτ ]
  end.

The same for a local definition with a module part (let_dm_sub_zeta): both sides meet at the body under the two extended substitutions.
Ltac sub_eq_let_dm_case :=
  match goal with
  | Hσ : wf_sub_eq ?Θ ?Ξ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ ?σ', HU : wf_unit_eq _ _ ?Γ (gu_mk nil (md_alias ?E)) _,
    HC : wf_exp _ _ (ce_dm ?A ?M (gu_mk nil (md_alias ?E)) :: ?Γ) ?S ?C, HB : wf_exp _ _ (ce_dm ?A ?M _ :: ?Γ) ?C ?B,
    HM : wf_exp _ _ ?Γ ?A ?M,
    Hl : wf_sub _ _ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ, Hr : wf_sub _ _ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ',
    IHC : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ (ce_dm _ _ _ :: ?Γ) _ _ -> wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?C _) _,
    IHB : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ (ce_dm _ _ _ :: ?Γ) _ _ -> wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?B _) _,
    IHM : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ ?Γ _ _ -> wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?M _) _,
    IHU : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ ?Γ _ _ -> wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub (gu_mk nil (md_alias ?E)) _) _ /\ _ |- _ =>
      let HS := fresh "HS" in let Hm := fresh "Hm" in let Hτ := fresh "Hτ" in let HCτ := fresh "HCτ" in
      let HMl := fresh "HMl" in let HMr := fresh "HMr" in
      assert (HS : type_sort S) by constructor;
      assert (Hm : module_body_sort S) by constructor;
      assert (HMl : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ M[σ] : A[σ]) by (eapply sub_preserves_exp; eassumption);
      assert (HMr : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ M[σ'] : A[σ']) by (eapply sub_preserves_exp; eassumption);
      assert (Hτ : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ0 ⊢ˢ σ ,,ᵈ M[σ] ‖ me_lit (gu_mk nil (md_alias E))[σ]ᵘ ≈ σ' ,,ᵈ M[σ'] ‖ me_lit (gu_mk nil (md_alias E))[σ']ᵘ
                    : Γ ▸ₘ A ≔ M ‖ gu_mk nil (md_alias E))
        by (eapply wf_sub_eq_extend_dm; [ exact Hσ | eassumption | exact HM | exact HU | exact HMl | exact HMr
                                        | exact (wf_exp_eq_refl HMl) | exact (wf_exp_eq_refl HMr) | exact (IHM _ _ _ Hσ)
                                        | exact (proj1 (IHU _ _ _ Hσ)) ]);
      rewrite exp_sub_extend_dm_sub;
      pose proof (IHC _ _ _ Hτ) as HCτ; try rewrite (type_sort_sub S _) in HCτ by exact HS;
      eapply wf_exp_eq_meet;
        [ eapply let_dm_sub_zeta; [ exact Hl | eassumption | exact HM | exact HU | exact HC | exact HS | exact Hm | exact HB ]
        | exact (IHB _ _ _ Hτ)
        | eapply let_dm_sub_zeta; [ exact Hr | eassumption | exact HM | exact HU | exact HC | exact HS | exact Hm | exact HB ]
        | eapply sub_preserves_sort; [ exact HC | exact HS | eapply wf_sub_eq_left; exact Hτ ]
        | exact HS | exact HCτ ]
  end.

Lemma sub_eq_preserves_mut :
  (forall Θ Ξ Δ A M, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ M : A ->
     forall Γ σ σ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M[σ] ≈ M[σ'] : A[σ]) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Δ A M M', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A -> True) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Δ A A', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ A ⊆ A' -> True) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Δ U, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵤ U -> True) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Δ Ψ Ψ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' ->
     forall Γ σ σ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
       (all_assumptions Ψ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Ψ σ ++ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Ψ) σ ≈ sb_qn (length Ψ) σ' : Ψ ++ Δ /\
                       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ tele_sub Ψ σ ≈ tele_sub Ψ σ') /\
       (all_assumptions Ψ' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_sub Ψ' σ ++ Γ ⊢ˢ sb_qn (length Ψ') σ ≈ sb_qn (length Ψ') σ' : Ψ' ++ Δ /\
                        Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ tele_sub Ψ' σ ≈ tele_sub Ψ' σ')) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Δ U U', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' ->
     forall Γ σ σ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U[σ]ᵘ ≈ U[σ']ᵘ /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U'[σ]ᵘ ≈ U'[σ']ᵘ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Δ H H', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' ->
     forall Γ σ σ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H[σ]ᵐ ≈ H[σ']ᵐ /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H'[σ]ᵐ ≈ H'[σ']ᵐ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Δ R, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ⁿˡ R -> True).
Proof.
  apply syntactic_wf_mut_ind'; intros; try exact I.
Units: a body by its filled-in entries, an alias by its target.
  all: try solve [ eapply sub_eq_unit_body_case; first [ eassumption | eapply mk_levels_flag; eassumption ] ].
A body unit and its expansion: expansion commutes with substitution.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | IH : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub (gu_open ?Δ ?Φ) _) _ /\ _,
      Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _
      |- _ /\ wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub (gu_open ?Δ (gm_expand ?Φ)) _) _ =>
        destruct (IH _ _ _ Hσ) as [HU _]; split; [ exact HU |];
        rewrite !gunit_sub_mk in HU |- *; cbn [moddef_sub] in HU |- *; rewrite <- !gm_expand_sub;
        apply wf_unit_eq_expand_cong; exact HU
    end ].
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ ?σ ?σ', HΔ : wf_ext_eq _ _ _ ?Δu ?Δu',
      IHΔ : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> (all_assumptions ?Δu -> _) /\ (all_assumptions ?Δu' -> _),
      Ha : all_assumptions ?Δu, Ha' : all_assumptions ?Δu', HE : wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ ?E ?E', HE' : wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ ?E' ?E',
      IHE : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?E _) _ /\ _,
      IHE' : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?E' _) _ /\ _
      |- wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub (gu_mk ?Δu (md_alias ?E)) ?σ) _ /\ _ =>
        destruct (IHΔ _ _ _ Hσ) as [HL HR]; destruct (HL Ha) as [L HΔσ]; destruct (HR Ha') as [L' HΔσ'];
        split; [ eapply sub_eq_unit_alias_self; [ exact Hσ | exact L | exact HΔσ | exact Ha | eapply wf_modexp_eq_refl_left; exact HE
                                                | intros; exact (proj1 (IHE _ _ _ ltac:(eassumption)))
                                                | eassumption | eassumption | eapply mk_levels_flag; eassumption | eassumption ]
               | eapply sub_eq_unit_alias_self; [ exact Hσ | exact L' | exact HΔσ' | exact Ha' | exact HE'
                                                | intros; exact (proj1 (IHE' _ _ _ ltac:(eassumption)))
                                                | eassumption | eassumption | eapply mk_levels_flag; eassumption | eassumption ] ]
    end ].
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ ?σ ?σ', HΔ : wf_ext_eq _ _ _ ?Δ ?Δ,
      IHΔ : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> (all_assumptions ?Δ -> _) /\ _,
      Ha : all_assumptions ?Δ, HU : wf_unit_eq _ _ (?Δ ++ _) (gu_mk ?Δ' ?D) _,
      IHU : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub (gu_mk ?Δ' ?D) _) _ /\ _
      |- wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub (gu_mk ?Δ (md_alias (me_lit (gu_mk ?Δ' ?D)))) ?σ) _ /\ _ =>
        destruct (IHΔ _ _ _ Hσ) as [HL _]; destruct (HL Ha) as [L HΔσ];
        eapply sub_eq_unit_flatten_case;
        [ exact Hσ | exact L | exact HΔσ | exact HΔ | exact Ha | exact HU | intros; exact (proj1 (IHU _ _ _ ltac:(eassumption)))
        | eassumption | eassumption | eapply mk_levels_flag; eassumption | eassumption ]
    end ].
Symmetry and transitivity: each side as the induction hypotheses give it.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ ?σ ?σ', IH : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub ?U _) _ /\ wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub ?U' _) _
      |- wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub ?U' ?σ) _ /\ wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub ?U ?σ) _ =>
        destruct (IH _ _ _ Hσ); split; assumption
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ ?σ ?σ', IH : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?H _) _ /\ wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?H' _) _
      |- wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?H' ?σ) _ /\ wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?H ?σ) _ =>
        destruct (IH _ _ _ Hσ); split; assumption
    end ].
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ ?σ ?σ',
      IH1 : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub ?U _) _ /\ _,
      IH2 : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> _ /\ wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub ?U'' _) _
      |- wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub ?U ?σ) _ /\ wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub ?U'' ?σ) _ =>
        split; [ exact (proj1 (IH1 _ _ _ Hσ)) | exact (proj2 (IH2 _ _ _ Hσ)) ]
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ ?σ ?σ',
      IH1 : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?H _) _ /\ _,
      IH2 : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> _ /\ wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?H'' _) _
      |- wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?H ?σ) _ /\ wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?H'' ?σ) _ =>
        split; [ exact (proj1 (IH1 _ _ _ Hσ)) | exact (proj2 (IH2 _ _ _ Hσ)) ]
    end ].
Module expressions.
  all: try solve [ cbn; split; eapply wf_me_unit; first [ eapply wf_sub_eq_left; eassumption | eassumption ] ].
  all: try solve [
    match goal with Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _, Hx : _ ∋ #?x ≔ₘ _ |- wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub (me_var ?x) _) _ /\ _ =>
      cbn; split; eapply wf_sub_eq_apply_mod; eassumption end ].
  all: try solve [ cbn; match goal with IH : forall _ _ _, _ -> wf_unit_eq _ _ _ _ _ /\ wf_unit_eq _ _ _ _ _, Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
                     destruct (IH _ _ _ Hσ); split; apply wf_me_lit; assumption end ].
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ ?σ ?σ', HH : wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ ?H ?H',
      IH : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?H _) _ /\ wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?H' _) _,
      Hm : mdenote _ _ _ (me_mem ?H ?y) _, Hm' : mdenote _ _ _ (me_mem ?H' ?y) _
      |- wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub (me_mem ?H ?y) ?σ) _ /\ _ =>
        pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hl; pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hr;
        pose proof (wf_modexp_eq_refl_left HH) as HHl; pose proof (wf_modexp_eq_refl_right HH) as HHr;
        destruct (IH _ _ _ Hσ) as [IH1 IH2]; cbn; split; eapply wf_me_mem;
        first [ exact IH1 | exact IH2
              | eapply wf_sub_mdenote_mem; [ exact HHl | exact Hm | eassumption ]
              | eapply wf_sub_mdenote_mem; [ exact HHr | exact Hm' | eassumption ]
              | eapply wf_sub_mdesc_mod_tele_mem; [ exact HHl | exact Hm | eassumption | eassumption ]
              | eapply wf_sub_mdesc_mod_tele_mem; [ exact HHr | exact Hm' | eassumption | eassumption ] ]
    end ].
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ ?σ ?σ', HH : wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ ?H ?H',
      IH : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?H _) _ /\ wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?H' _) _,
      HB : wf_exp _ _ _ ?S ?B, HSr : evaluated_sort ?S,
      IHB : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?B _) _,
      HN : wf_exp _ _ _ ?B ?N, IHN : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?N _) _,
      HB' : wf_exp _ _ _ ?S' ?B', HSr' : evaluated_sort ?S',
      IHB' : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?B' _) _,
      HN' : wf_exp _ _ _ ?B' ?N', IHN' : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?N' _) _,
      Hm : mdenote _ _ _ ?H ?R, HT : mdesc_mod_tele ?R = Some _, Hv : tele_view _ = Some (?B, _),
      Hm' : mdenote _ _ _ ?H' ?R', HT' : mdesc_mod_tele ?R' = Some _, Hv' : tele_view _ = Some (?B', _)
      |- wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub (me_app ?H ?N) ?σ) _ /\ _ =>
        pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hl; pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hr;
        pose proof (wf_modexp_eq_refl_left HH) as HHl; pose proof (wf_modexp_eq_refl_right HH) as HHr;
        assert (HtS : type_sort S) by (destruct HSr; constructor);
        assert (HtS' : type_sort S') by (destruct HSr'; constructor);
        destruct (IH _ _ _ Hσ) as [IH1 IH2]; cbn; split; eapply wf_me_app;
        [ exact IH1
        | eapply wf_sub_mdenote; [ exact HHl | exact Hm | exact Hl ]
        | eapply wf_sub_mdesc_mod_tele; [ exact HHl | exact Hm | exact HT | exact Hl ]
        | eapply tele_view_sub_some; exact Hv
        | exact (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HB HtS Hl) | exact HSr
        | eapply sub_preserves_exp; [ exact HN | exact Hl ]
        | exact (IHN _ _ _ Hσ)
        | eapply wf_sub_mdenote; [ exact HHl | exact Hm | exact Hr ]
        | eapply wf_sub_mdesc_mod_tele; [ exact HHl | exact Hm | exact HT | exact Hr ]
        | eapply tele_view_sub_some; exact Hv
        | exact (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HB HtS Hr) | exact HSr
        | eapply sub_preserves_exp; [ exact HN | exact Hr ]
        | exact IH2
        | eapply wf_sub_mdenote; [ exact HHr | exact Hm' | exact Hl ]
        | eapply wf_sub_mdesc_mod_tele; [ exact HHr | exact Hm' | exact HT' | exact Hl ]
        | eapply tele_view_sub_some; exact Hv'
        | exact (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HB' HtS' Hl) | exact HSr'
        | eapply sub_preserves_exp; [ exact HN' | exact Hl ]
        | exact (IHN' _ _ _ Hσ)
        | eapply wf_sub_mdenote; [ exact HHr | exact Hm' | exact Hr ]
        | eapply wf_sub_mdesc_mod_tele; [ exact HHr | exact Hm' | exact HT' | exact Hr ]
        | eapply tele_view_sub_some; exact Hv'
        | exact (sub_preserves_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HB' HtS' Hr) | exact HSr'
        | eapply sub_preserves_exp; [ exact HN' | exact Hr ] ]
    end ].
δ for a slot: the slot's two images, each its unit.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq ?T ?X ?G0 ?G ?σ ?σ', Hx : _ ∋ #?x ≔ₘ ?U |- wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub (me_var ?x) _) _ /\ wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub (me_lit ?U) _) _ =>
        pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hl; pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hr;
        assert (Hlit : forall s, T ⍮ X ⍮ G0 ⊢ˢ s : G -> T ⍮ X ⍮ G0 ⊢ᵐ sentry_modexp (s x) ≈ me_lit U[s]ᵘ)
          by (intros s Hs; destruct (wf_sub_apply_mod _ _ _ _ _ Hs _ _ Hx) as [[-> HUσ] | (y & -> & Hy)]; cbn;
              [ apply wf_me_lit; exact HUσ | eapply wf_me_delta_slot; [ eapply wf_sub_dom; exact Hs | exact Hy ] ]);
        cbn; split; [ eapply wf_sub_eq_apply_mod; eassumption |];
        eapply wf_me_trans; [ apply wf_me_sym; exact (Hlit _ Hl) |];
        eapply wf_me_trans; [ eapply wf_sub_eq_apply_mod; eassumption | exact (Hlit _ Hr) ]
    end ].
δ for a selection: the unit side through the selection, each image its unit.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ ?σ ?σ', HH : wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (me_mem ?H ?y) (me_mem ?H ?y),
      Hm : mdenote _ _ _ (me_mem ?H ?y) ?R, Hd : mdesc_mod ?R = Some ?Rm,
      IHs : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub (me_mem ?H ?y) _) _ /\ _
      |- wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub (me_mem ?H ?y) ?σ) _ /\ wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub (mdesc_unit ?Rm) _) _ =>
        pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hl; pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hr;
        pose proof (wf_me_delta_sel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HH Hm Hd) as Hδ;
        split; [ exact (proj1 (IHs _ _ _ Hσ)) |];
        eapply wf_me_trans; [ apply wf_me_sym; eapply sub_preserves_modexp; [ exact Hδ | exact Hl ] |];
        eapply wf_me_trans; [ exact (proj1 (IHs _ _ _ Hσ)) | eapply sub_preserves_modexp; [ exact Hδ | exact Hr ] ]
    end ].
β: the redex from one substitution to the other, the reduct through it.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ ?σ ?σ', HU : wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gu_mk (?Δ ++ ce_ass ?κ ?X :: nil) ?D) _,
      IHU : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_unit_eq _ _ _ (gunit_sub (gu_mk (?Δ ++ ce_ass ?κ ?X :: nil) ?D) _) _ /\ _,
      HN : wf_exp _ _ _ ?X ?N, IHN : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?N _) _ |- _ =>
        pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hl; pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hr;
        assert (Hred : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵐ modexp_sub (me_app (me_lit (gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D)) N) σ
                                    ≈ modexp_sub (me_app (me_lit (gu_mk (Δ ++ ce_ass κ X :: nil) D)) N) σ')
          by (cbn [modexp_sub]; pose proof (proj1 (IHU _ _ _ Hσ)) as HUσ; rewrite !gunit_sub_last in HUσ |- *;
              eapply lit_app_cong; [ exact HUσ | eapply sub_preserves_exp; [ exact HN | exact Hl ] | exact (IHN _ _ _ Hσ)
                                   | eapply sub_preserves_exp; [ exact HN | exact Hr ] ]);
        split; [ exact Hred |];
        eapply wf_me_trans; [ apply wf_me_sym; eapply sub_preserves_modexp; [ first [ eapply wf_me_beta_body | eapply wf_me_beta_alias ]; eassumption | exact Hl ] |];
        eapply wf_me_trans; [ exact Hred | eapply sub_preserves_modexp; [ first [ eapply wf_me_beta_body | eapply wf_me_beta_alias ]; eassumption | exact Hr ] ]
    end ].
An alias with no parameter: its target through it.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ ?σ ?σ', HE : wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ ?E ?E, Hf : frame_free_target _ _ _ ?E,
      IHE : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?E _) _ /\ _
      |- wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub (me_lit (gu_mk nil (md_alias ?E))) ?σ) _ /\ _ =>
        pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hl; pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hr;
        split; [| exact (proj1 (IHE _ _ _ Hσ)) ];
        eapply wf_me_trans; [ eapply sub_preserves_modexp; [ eapply wf_me_beta_alias0; [ exact HE | exact Hf ] | exact Hl ] |];
        eapply wf_me_trans; [ exact (proj1 (IHE _ _ _ Hσ)) |];
        apply wf_me_sym; eapply sub_preserves_modexp; [ eapply wf_me_beta_alias0; [ exact HE | exact Hf ] | exact Hr ]
    end ].
A member: the module expression from one substitution to the other; the right-hand side typed at the left one's type by the equation of the type the premise gives.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ ?σ ?σ', HH : wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ ?H ?H, Hm : mdenote _ _ _ (me_mem ?H ?x) ?R,
      Ht : mdesc_type ?R = Some ?A, HA : wf_exp _ _ _ ?S ?A, HS : type_sort ?S,
      HMr : forall _, mdesc_reduct ?R = Some _ -> wf_exp _ _ _ ?A _,
      IHA : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?A _) _,
      IH : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> wf_modexp_eq _ _ _ (modexp_sub ?H _) _ /\ _
      |- wf_exp_eq _ _ _ (exp_sub ?A ?σ) (exp_sub (a_mem ?H ?x) ?σ) (exp_sub (a_mem ?H ?x) ?σ') =>
        pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hl; pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hr;
        let Hc := fresh "Hc" in
        pose proof (wf_gctx_closed _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HH)) as Hc;
        pose proof (IHA _ _ _ Hσ) as HAσ; rewrite type_sort_sub in HAσ by exact HS;
        cbn [exp_sub]; eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_cong;
        [ exact (proj1 (IH _ _ _ Hσ))
        | eapply wf_sub_mdenote_mem; [ exact HH | exact Hm | exact Hl ]
        | eapply mdesc_type_sub; exact Ht
        | eapply wf_sub_mdenote_mem; [ exact HH | exact Hm | exact Hr ]
        | eapply mdesc_type_sub; exact Ht
        | eapply wf_exp_subtyp;
          [ eapply wf_mem; [ eapply sub_preserves_modexp; [ exact HH | exact Hr ]
                           | eapply wf_sub_mdenote_mem; [ exact HH | exact Hm | exact Hr ]
                           | eapply mdesc_type_sub; exact Ht
                           | eapply sub_preserves_sort; [ exact HA | exact HS | exact Hr ]
                           | exact HS
                           | let HM' := fresh "HM'" in
                             intros ? HM'; destruct (mdesc_reduct_sub_inv _ _ _ HM') as (? & ? & ->);
                             eapply sub_preserves_exp; [ eapply HMr; eassumption | exact Hr ] ]
          | eapply sub_preserves_sort; [ exact HA | exact HS | exact Hl ]
          | exact HS
          | eapply wf_subtyp_refl; [ eapply sub_preserves_sort; [ exact HA | exact HS | exact Hl ] | exact HS
                                   | apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact HAσ ] ] ]
    end ].
Π: by the kind of its universe. The records, before the universe premise of the type former is inverted.
  all: try solve [ first [ eapply sub_eq_record_case | eapply sub_eq_tuple_case | eapply sub_eq_proj_case ];
                   eassumption ].
  all: repeat match goal with Hu : wf_is_univ _ _ _ _ |- _ => inversion Hu; subst; clear Hu end.
Telescopes of assumptions: the substitutions are lifted entry by entry, at the equation of the entry's type the induction hypothesis gives.
  all: try solve [ cbn; split; intros _; (split; [ assumption | apply wf_ext_eq_nil; eapply wf_sub_dom, wf_sub_eq_left; eassumption ]) ].
  all: try solve [ split; intros Hass; inversion Hass as [| ? ? (? & ? & Heq) ? ]; discriminate ].
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | HΨ : wf_ext_eq _ _ ?Δ ?Ψ ?Ψ', IHx : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ -> (all_assumptions ?Ψ -> _) /\ (all_assumptions ?Ψ' -> _),
      HA : wf_exp _ _ (?Ψ ++ ?Δ) ?S ?A,
      HS : sort_kind ?S _,
      IHA : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ (?Ψ ++ ?Δ) _ _ -> wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?A _) _,
      HA' : wf_exp _ _ (?Ψ' ++ ?Δ) ?S' ?A',
      HS' : sort_kind ?S' _,
      IHA' : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ (?Ψ' ++ ?Δ) _ _ -> wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?A' _) _,
      Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ ?Γ ?Δ ?σ ?σ' |- _ =>
        destruct (IHx _ _ _ Hσ) as [IHl IHr];
        split; intros Hass; inversion_clear Hass as [| ? ? _ Hass'];
        [ destruct (IHl Hass') as [Hl HE];
          exact (sub_eq_ext_ass_diag _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HE (ext_eq_ctx_left _ _ _ _ _ HΨ) HA HS IHA Hσ)
        | destruct (IHr Hass') as [Hl HE];
          exact (sub_eq_ext_ass_diag _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HE (ext_eq_ctx_right _ _ _ _ _ HΨ) HA' HS' IHA' Hσ) ]
    end ].
The eliminator.
  all: try solve [ eapply sub_eq_elim_case; eassumption ].
A proof: it is typed again from the rule's premises, and so is its proposition, for the irrelevance step below.
  all: try match goal with
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ ?σ' |- wf_exp_eq _ _ ?Γ0 (exp_sub ?A ?σ) (exp_sub ?X ?σ) (exp_sub ?X ?σ') =>
        let HX := fresh "HX" in let HAP := fresh "HAP" in
        assert (HX : wf_exp _ _ Γ A X)
          by (solve [ eauto 2 using wf_conj, wf_left, wf_right, wf_proof_tag ]);
        assert (HAP : wf_exp _ _ Γ a_prop A) by (solve [ eauto 2 using wf_and ])
    end.
Where the proposition is a premise, its induction hypothesis moves it to the other substitution, and both sides are proofs of it.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hσ : wf_sub_eq _ _ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ ?σ', HX : wf_exp _ _ ?Γ ?A ?X, HAP : wf_exp _ _ ?Γ a_prop ?A,
      IHA : forall _ _ _, wf_sub_eq _ _ _ ?Γ _ _ -> wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?A _) (exp_sub ?A _)
      |- wf_exp_eq _ _ ?Γ0 (exp_sub ?A ?σ) (exp_sub ?X ?σ) (exp_sub ?X ?σ') =>
        let Hl := fresh "Hl" in let Hr := fresh "Hr" in let HAl := fresh "HAl" in
        pose proof (wf_sub_eq_left _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hl; pose proof (wf_sub_eq_right _ _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) as Hr;
        pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HAP Hl) as HAl;
        eapply wf_exp_eq_irrelevant;
        [ exact HAl | exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HX Hl)
        | eapply wf_exp_subtyp;
          [ exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HX Hr) | exact HAl | constructor
          | eapply wf_subtyp_refl; [ exact HAl | constructor | apply wf_exp_eq_sym; exact (IHA _ _ _ Hσ) ] ] ]
    end ].
  all: destruct_type_sort; try discriminate; saturate_sub_eq; push_sub; lift_sub_eq; saturate_sub_eq;
    saturate_sub_typ; saturate_sub_eq_IH.
In the a_glob case the recorded type reaches Γ only through saturate_sub_typ, i.e. after push_sub has run.
  all: try solve [ push_closed; mauto 3 ].
The type former and the constructors: their types are closed.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hl : ind_lookup _ _ _ = Some ?D, Hσ : wf_sub _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
        let HD := fresh "HD" in
        assert (HD : decl_closed D)
          by (eapply gctx_closed_ind; [ eapply wf_gctx_closed, (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) | exact Hl ]);
        try (erewrite (ind_ty_sub D) by eassumption); try (erewrite (con_ty_sub _ D) by eassumption);
        first [ eapply wf_exp_eq_ind_cong | eapply wf_exp_eq_con_cong ]; eauto using wf_sub_dom
    end ].
The module of an inductive type as a term: its chain is closed, and both sides unfold to the type former.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | Hl : ind_lookup _ _ _ = Some ?D, Hp : mod_qname _ = Some _, Hσ : wf_sub _ _ _ _ ?σ |- _ =>
        let HD := fresh "HD" in
        assert (HD : decl_closed D)
          by (eapply gctx_closed_ind; [ eapply wf_gctx_closed, (wf_sub_dom _ _ _ _ _ Hσ) | exact Hl ]);
        rewrite (ind_ty_sub D _ HD); cbn [exp_sub]; rewrite !(mod_qname_sub _ _ _ Hp);
        eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
        [ eapply wf_exp_eq_mem_glob_ind_unfold | eapply wf_exp_eq_sym, wf_exp_eq_mem_glob_ind_unfold ];
        eauto using wf_sub_dom
    end ].
  all: try solve [ mauto 3 ].
Applications at a tag: the rule at the tag of the function's Π.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | HM : wf_exp _ _ _ (a_pi ?kd ?kc _ _) _ |- wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (a_app _ _) _ =>
        eapply wf_exp_eq_app_cong with (κd := kd) (κc := kc);
        first [ solve [ eassumption | constructor ] | mauto 3 ]
    end ].
Π at its kinds: the domain is of the sort of its kind, the codomain's sort commutes with the lifted substitution.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | |- wf_exp_eq _ _ _ _ (a_pi ?kd ?kc _ _) _ =>
        (* a universe is read off the domain or the codomain when either
           is relevant; a type of levels into propositions or levels reads
           none, and Typeω@0 is taken *)
        let U0 := lazymatch kd with
                  | ak_relevant => open_constr:(_)
                  | _ => lazymatch kc with ak_relevant => open_constr:(_) | _ => constr:(Typeω@0) end
                  end in
        eapply wf_exp_eq_pi_cong with (U := U0) (κd := kd) (κc := kc);
        [ idtac
        | first [ eassumption | eapply sub_preserves_exp; eassumption
                | match goal with
                  | HA : wf_exp _ _ _ _ ?A, Hs : wf_sub _ _ _ _ ?s |- wf_exp _ _ _ _ (exp_sub ?A ?s) =>
                      exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA Hs)
                  end ]
        | eassumption
        | cbn [abs_kind_sort exp_wk]; try rewrite <- exp_wk_shift_sub_q; eassumption | constructor ];
        first [ eassumption | apply wf_is_univ_large; eassumption
              | match goal with
                | HL : wf_exp _ _ ?D (a_level _) ?L0, Hs : wf_sub _ _ _ ?D ?s |- _ =>
                    let Hu := fresh "Hu" in
                    pose proof (sub_preserves_univ _ _ _ _ (a_univ L0) s ltac:(eapply wf_is_univ_small; exact HL) Hs) as Hu;
                    exact Hu
                end ]
    end ].
A proof: both sides are proofs of the moved proposition, equal by irrelevance.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | HX : wf_exp _ _ ?Γ ?A ?X, HAP : wf_exp _ _ ?Γ a_prop ?A,
      Hl : wf_sub _ _ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ, Hr : wf_sub _ _ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ' |- wf_exp_eq _ _ ?Γ0 _ _ _ =>
        let HAl := fresh "HAl" in pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HAP Hl) as HAl;
        eapply wf_exp_eq_irrelevant;
        [ exact HAl | exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HX Hl)
        | eapply wf_exp_subtyp;
          [ exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HX Hr) | exact HAl | constructor
          | eapply wf_subtyp_refl; [ exact HAl | constructor | cbn [exp_sub]; mauto 3 ] ] ]
    end ].
Ex falso: its congruence, at the moved target and scrutinee.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | HM : wf_exp _ _ ?Γ a_False ?M, Hl : wf_sub _ _ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ, Hr : wf_sub _ _ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ'
      |- wf_exp_eq _ _ ?Γ0 _ (a_absurd _ (exp_sub ?M ?σ)) (a_absurd _ (exp_sub ?M ?σ')) =>
        eapply wf_exp_eq_absurd_cong;
        [ eassumption | constructor | constructor | eassumption
        | exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hl) | exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hr) ]
    end ].
Ex falso at a target of any sort: the target moved by the left substitution, of its sort.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | HC : wf_exp _ _ ?Γ ?S ?C, HM : wf_exp _ _ ?Γ a_False ?M, Hl : wf_sub _ _ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ, Hr : wf_sub _ _ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ',
      HCe : wf_exp_eq _ _ ?Γ0 ?S (exp_sub ?C ?σ) (exp_sub ?C ?σ')
      |- wf_exp_eq _ _ ?Γ0 _ (a_absurd _ (exp_sub ?M ?σ)) (a_absurd _ (exp_sub ?M ?σ')) =>
        let HCl := fresh "HCl" in
        pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HC Hl) as HCl; rewrite (type_sort_sub S σ) in HCl by constructor;
        eapply wf_exp_eq_absurd_cong;
        [ exact HCl | constructor | constructor | exact HCe
        | exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hl) | exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hr) ]
    end ].
A λ or an application at a Π whose domain or codomain is of the types of levels: the congruence at the moved domain and codomain.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | HA : wf_exp _ _ ?Γ ?S ?A, HB : wf_exp _ _ (ce_ass ?kd ?A :: ?Γ) ?S' ?B,
      Hl : wf_sub _ _ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ, Hq : wf_sub _ _ _ (ce_ass ?kd ?A :: ?Γ) (sb_q ?σ)
      |- wf_exp_eq _ _ ?Γ0 _ _ _ =>
        let kc := kind_of_sort S' in
        let HAl := fresh "HAl" in let HBq := fresh "HBq" in
        pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA Hl) as HAl; rewrite (type_sort_sub S σ) in HAl by constructor;
        pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HB Hq) as HBq; rewrite (type_sort_sub S' (sb_q σ)) in HBq by constructor;
        first [ eapply wf_exp_eq_fn_cong with (κd := kd) (κc := kc);
                [ exact HAl | constructor | eassumption | exact HBq | constructor | eassumption ]
              | eapply wf_exp_eq_app_cong with (κd := kd) (κc := kc);
                [ exact HAl | constructor | exact HBq | constructor | eassumption | eassumption ] ]
    end ].
A local definition whose type is of any sort: the congruence at the moved annotation and definiens.
  all: try solve [
    match goal with
    | HA : wf_exp _ _ ?Γ ?S ?A, HM : wf_exp _ _ ?Γ ?A ?M, HC : wf_exp _ _ (ce_def ?A ?M :: ?Γ) ?SC ?C,
      Hl : wf_sub _ _ ?Γ0 ?Γ ?σ, Hq : wf_sub _ _ _ (ce_def ?A ?M :: ?Γ) (sb_q ?σ)
      |- wf_exp_eq _ _ ?Γ0 _ (a_let (b_def (exp_sub ?A ?σ) (exp_sub ?M ?σ)) _) _ =>
        let HAl := fresh "HAl" in let HCq := fresh "HCq" in
        pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HA Hl) as HAl; rewrite (type_sort_sub S σ) in HAl by constructor;
        pose proof (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HC Hq) as HCq; rewrite (type_sort_sub SC (sb_q σ)) in HCq by constructor;
        eapply wf_exp_eq_let_cong;
        [ exact HAl | constructor | eassumption | exact (sub_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hl) | eassumption
        | exact HCq | constructor | eassumption ]
    end ].
A local module: both sides are reduced by ζ and meet at the body under the two extended substitutions, at the body's type. A local definition with a module part, likewise.
  all: try solve [ sub_eq_let_dm_case ].
  all: sub_eq_let_mod_case.
The level of a propositional rule's universe is never read: Propₘ does not mention it.
  Unshelve. all: exact 0.
Qed.

Corollary sub_eq_preserves_exp : forall Θ Ξ Δ A M,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ M : A ->
    forall Γ σ σ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M[σ] ≈ M[σ'] : A[σ].
Proof. exact (proj1 sub_eq_preserves_mut). Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve sub_eq_preserves_exp : mctt.

Equivalent substitutions move a well-formed module expression and a well-formed unit to equal ones.
Corollary sub_eq_preserves_modexp : forall Θ Ξ Δ H H',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' ->
    forall Γ σ σ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H[σ]ᵐ ≈ H[σ']ᵐ.
Proof.
  intros * HH * Hσ; destruct sub_eq_preserves_mut as (_ & _ & _ & _ & _ & _ & HM & _).
  exact (proj1 (HM _ _ _ _ _ HH _ _ _ Hσ)).
Qed.

Corollary sub_eq_preserves_unit : forall Θ Ξ Δ U U',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' ->
    forall Γ σ σ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U[σ]ᵘ ≈ U[σ']ᵘ.
Proof.
  intros * HU * Hσ; destruct sub_eq_preserves_mut as (_ & _ & _ & _ & _ & HUU & _).
  exact (proj1 (HUU _ _ _ _ _ HU _ _ _ Hσ)).
Qed.

Corollary sub_eq_preserves_typ : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ A σ σ' i,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ A[σ'] : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  intros.
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ exp_sub A σ ≈ exp_sub A σ' : exp_sub (a_typ i) σ) by mauto 2.
  assumption.
Qed.

The same at any sort: a large universe or Prop.
Corollary sub_eq_preserves_sort : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ A σ σ' Srt,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ⊢ A : Srt ->
    type_sort Srt ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ A[σ'] : Srt.
Proof.
  intros * HA HS Hσ; rewrite <- (type_sort_sub _ σ HS); exact (sub_eq_preserves_exp _ _ _ _ _ HA _ _ _ Hσ).
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve sub_eq_preserves_typ sub_eq_preserves_sort : mctt.

Substitution Equivalence is a PER

Both directions need to move an image from A[σ] to A[σ'], which is what sub_eq_preserves_typ and ctx_lookup_wf together provide.

Lemma wf_sub_eq_sym : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ' ≈ σ : Δ.
Proof.
  intros * H; saturate_sub_eq.
  econstructor; [ mauto 2 | mauto 2 | |].
  - intros x A Hlk.
    destruct (ctx_lookup_wf_sorted _ _ _ _ _ ltac:(eassumption) Hlk) as (S & HS & HA).
    assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ A[σ'] : S) by (eapply sub_eq_preserves_sort; eassumption).
    eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp';
      [ symmetry; eapply wf_sub_eq_apply; eassumption
      | eapply wf_subtyp_refl; [ eapply sub_preserves_sort; eassumption | exact HS | assumption ] ].
  - intros x U Hl; apply wf_me_sym; eapply wf_sub_eq_apply_mod; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sub_eq_trans : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ' σ'',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ' ≈ σ'' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ'' : Δ.
Proof.
  intros * H1 H2; saturate_sub_eq.
  econstructor; [ mauto 2 | mauto 2 | |].
  - intros x A Hlk.
    destruct (ctx_lookup_wf_sorted _ _ _ _ _ ltac:(eassumption) Hlk) as (S & HS & HA).
    assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A[σ] ≈ A[σ'] : S) by (eapply sub_eq_preserves_sort; eassumption).
    assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ #x[σ'] ≈ #x[σ''] : A[σ]) by
      (eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp';
       [ eapply wf_sub_eq_apply; eassumption
       | eapply wf_subtyp_refl; [ eapply sub_preserves_sort; eassumption | exact HS | symmetry; assumption ] ]).
    etransitivity; [ eapply wf_sub_eq_apply; eassumption | eassumption ].
  - intros x U Hl; eapply wf_me_trans; eapply wf_sub_eq_apply_mod; eassumption.
Qed.

#[export]
Instance wf_sub_eq_PER Θ Ξ Γ Δ : PER (wf_sub_eq Θ Ξ Γ Δ).
Proof.
  split.
  - eauto using wf_sub_eq_sym.
  - eauto using wf_sub_eq_trans.
Qed.

#[export]
Instance wf_sub_eq_per_elem Θ Ξ Γ Δ : PERElem _ (wf_sub Θ Ξ Γ Δ) (wf_sub_eq Θ Ξ Γ Δ).
Proof.
  intros ? ?; mauto 2.
Qed.

sb_eq is not a Leibniz equality, so a pointwise rearrangement of a substitution — sb_compose_assoc and its kin — has to be turned into a judgmental one before it can be used on a judgment that is not Proper for it, such as a gluing predicate.
Lemma wf_sub_eq_of_sb_eq : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ : Δ ->
    sb_eq σ σ' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ.
Proof.
  intros * ? Heq.
  econstructor; [ eassumption | now rewrite <- Heq | |].
  - intros x A ?; change (exp_sub (a_var x) σ') with (sentry_exp (σ' x)); rewrite <- (Heq x); mauto 2.
  - intros x U Hl; rewrite <- (Heq x); eapply wf_sub_mod_image; eassumption.
Qed.

Composition of Equivalent Substitutions

The two one-sided halves are sub_preserves_exp_eq and sub_eq_preserves_exp respectively; the full congruence is their composite.

Lemma wf_sub_eq_compose_left : forall Θ Ξ Γ Γ' Δ σ σ' τ,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ˢ τ : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ˢ σ ⨟ τ ≈ σ' ⨟ τ : Δ.
Proof.
  intros * H ?; saturate_sub_eq.
  econstructor; [ mauto 2 | mauto 2 | |].
  - intros x A ?; reduce_index; rewrite <- exp_sub_sub, <- !sentry_exp_sub; fold (exp_sub (a_var x) σ) (exp_sub (a_var x) σ').
    eapply sub_preserves_exp_eq; [ eapply wf_sub_eq_apply; eassumption | eassumption ].
  - intros x U Hl; cbn [sb_compose]; rewrite !sentry_modexp_sub.
    eapply sub_preserves_modexp; [ eapply wf_sub_eq_apply_mod; eassumption | eassumption ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_sub_eq_compose_right : forall Θ Ξ Γ Γ' Δ σ τ τ',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ˢ σ ⨟ τ ≈ σ ⨟ τ' : Δ.
Proof.
  intros * ? H; saturate_sub_eq.
  econstructor; [ mauto 2 | mauto 2 | |].
  - intros x A ?; reduce_index; rewrite <- exp_sub_sub, <- !sentry_exp_sub; fold (exp_sub (a_var x) σ).
    eapply sub_eq_preserves_exp; [ eapply wf_sub_apply; eassumption | eassumption ].
  - intros x U Hl; cbn [sb_compose]; rewrite !sentry_modexp_sub.
    eapply sub_eq_preserves_modexp; [ eapply wf_sub_mod_image; eassumption | eassumption ].
Qed.

Corollary wf_sub_eq_compose : forall Θ Ξ Γ Γ' Δ σ σ' τ τ',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ˢ τ ≈ τ' : Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ' ⊢ˢ σ ⨟ τ ≈ σ' ⨟ τ' : Δ.
Proof.
  intros * H1 H2; saturate_sub_eq.
  etransitivity;
    [ eapply wf_sub_eq_compose_left; [ eassumption | eassumption ]
    | eapply wf_sub_eq_compose_right; [ eassumption | eassumption ] ].
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_sub_eq_compose_left wf_sub_eq_compose_right wf_sub_eq_compose : mctt.

η-Expansion

The right-hand side of wf_exp_eq_fn_eta is well-typed at the same type as the left. Getting there is entirely a matter of moving between the two descriptions of a weakened Π-type: (Π A B)[↑]ʷ is Π A[↑]ʷ B[q ↑]ʷ, but only by computation, so eauto cannot see it and the step is taken by hand. The application's type is B[q ↑]ʷ[Id ,, #0], which is B by exp_wk_q_shift_single: lifting a weakening and then substituting the top variable for it is the identity.
Id ,, #0 and its variable form sb_extend Id (se_var 0) substitute the same terms, though not the same module expressions; on a well-typed term they agree judgmentally.
Lemma wf_sub_eq_var_zero : forall Θ Ξ Γ κ A Srt,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Srt ->
    sort_kind Srt κ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κ} A ⊢ˢ Id,,#0 ≈ sb_extend Id (se_var 0) : Γ ▹{κ} A ▹{κ} A[↑]ʷ.
Proof.
  intros * HA HS.
  assert (⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κ} A) by mauto 3.
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κ} A ⊢ʷ ↑ : Γ) by mauto 2.
  assert (HA' : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κ} A ⊢ A[↑]ʷ : Srt) by (eapply wk_preserves_sort; mauto 2).
  assert (Hv : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κ} A ⊢ #0 : A[↑]ʷ) by mauto 3.
  assert (Hl : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κ} A ⊢ˢ Id,,#0 : Γ ▹{κ} A ▹{κ} A[↑]ʷ) by (eapply wf_sub_single; [ exact HA' | exact HS | exact Hv ]).
  assert (Hr : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κ} A ⊢ˢ sb_extend Id (se_var 0) : Γ ▹{κ} A ▹{κ} A[↑]ʷ).
  { apply wf_sub_extend_gen; [ mauto 3 | mauto 3 | | |]; intros * Hlk; inversion Hlk; subst; cbn.
    rewrite exp_sub_shift_extend, exp_sub_id; exact Hv. }
  econstructor; [ exact Hl | exact Hr | |].
  - intros x B Hlk.
    replace (exp_sub (a_var x) (sb_extend Id (se_var 0))) with (exp_sub (a_var x) (Id,,#0)) by (destruct x; reflexivity).
    apply wf_exp_eq_refl; eapply wf_sub_apply; eassumption.
  - intros x U Hlk; inversion Hlk; subst; cbn; eapply wf_me_var; [ mauto 2 | eassumption ].
Qed.

A function over a type of the kind κd into a type of the kind κc (pi_kinds), moved under its domain and applied to the new variable, is of its codomain, at the premises of wf_exp_eq_fn_eta.
Lemma wf_app_var0 : forall Θ Ξ Γ κd κc A B M Srt i,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Srt ->
    sort_kind Srt κd ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊢ B : abs_kind_sort κc Typeω@i ->
    pi_kinds κd κc ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : a_pi κd κc A B ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊢ M[↑]ʷ $ #0 : B.
Proof.
  intros * HA HS HB Hc HM.
  assert (HSr : type_sort (abs_kind_sort κc Typeω@i)) by (apply type_sort_abs_kind; constructor).
  pose proof (sort_kind_type_sort _ _ HS) as HSt.
  assert (⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A) by mauto 3.
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊢ʷ ↑ : Γ) by mauto 2.
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊢ exp_wk M ↑ : exp_wk (a_pi κd κc A B) ↑) as H'
      by (eapply wk_preserves_exp; eassumption).
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊢ M[↑]ʷ : a_pi κd κc A[↑]ʷ B[wk_q ↑]ʷ) by exact H'.
  assert (HA' : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊢ A[↑]ʷ : Srt) by (eapply wk_preserves_sort; eassumption).
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊢ #0 : A[↑]ʷ) by mauto 3.
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ▹{κd} A[↑]ʷ ⊢ B[wk_q ↑]ʷ : abs_kind_sort κc Typeω@i)
      by (eapply wk_preserves_sort; [ eassumption | exact HSr | eapply (wf_wk_q' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Srt); eassumption ]).
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊢ M[↑]ʷ $ #0 : B[wk_q ↑]ʷ[Id,,#0])
    by (eapply wf_app with (i := i); [ exact HA' | exact HS | eassumption | exact Hc | eassumption | eassumption ]).
  assert (Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊢ B[wk_q ↑]ʷ[Id,,#0] ≈ B : abs_kind_sort κc Typeω@i).
  { rewrite <- (exp_wk_q_shift_single B) at 2.
    eapply sub_eq_preserves_sort; [ eassumption | exact HSr | eapply wf_sub_eq_var_zero; eassumption ]. }
  eapply wf_exp_subtyp'; [ eassumption |].
  eapply wf_subtyp_refl; [ eassumption | exact HSr | eassumption ].
Qed.

The η-expansion of such a function is of the same Π.
Lemma wf_fn_eta_expand : forall Θ Ξ Γ κd κc A B M Srt i,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Srt ->
    sort_kind Srt κd ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{κd} A ⊢ B : abs_kind_sort κc Typeω@i ->
    pi_kinds κd κc ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : a_pi κd κc A B ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ λ A M[↑]ʷ $ #0 : a_pi κd κc A B.
Proof.
  intros * HA HS HB Hc HM.
  eapply wf_fn with (i := i); [ exact HA | exact HS | exact HB | exact Hc |].
  eapply wf_app_var0; eassumption.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_fn_eta_expand : mctt.

Closed Neutrals

A neutral with no global at its head has a variable there, which the empty context has none of, or is an ex falso, whose proof is a closed proof of ⊥. So a clean neutral typed in the empty context proves ⊥; no model is needed. At a global context with an axiom bot : ⊥, efqⁿ bot return Prop is such a neutral: no stronger statement holds at every global context.

Lemma closed_clean_neutral_proves_False : forall {Θ Ξ A} {W : ne},
    ne_clean W ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅ ⊢ W : A ->
    exists M, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅ ⊢ M : ⊥.
Proof.
  intros * HW H.
  dependent induction H;
    (* subsumption: the same neutral *)
    try solve [ eapply IHwf_exp1; [ exact HW | reflexivity | reflexivity ] ];
    destruct W; try (simpl in *; congruence);
    autoinjections; cbn in *; destruct_all;
    eauto.
  all: try contradiction.
  all: try solve [ inversion_by_head ctx_lookup ].
Qed.

Conversion

Subsumption specialised to an equation. They come last because, registered as hints, they let eauto change the type of a goal at will — which is what the presupposition proof needs on almost every case, and what the proofs above are deliberately kept free of.

Lemma wf_conv : forall Θ Ξ Γ M A A' i,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A' : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A'.
Proof.
  intros; mauto 3.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_conv : forall Θ Ξ Γ M M' A A' i,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A' : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A'.
Proof.
  intros; mauto 3.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_conv wf_exp_eq_conv : mctt.

Conversion along an equation at any sort, a universe or Prop.
Lemma wf_conv_sort : forall Θ Ξ Γ M A A' Srt,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A' : Srt ->
    type_sort Srt ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Srt ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A'.
Proof.
  intros * HM HA' HS HAA; eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [ exact HM | exact HA' | exact HS |].
  eapply wf_subtyp_refl; [ exact HA' | exact HS | exact HAA ].
Qed.

The same for an equation of terms.
Lemma wf_exp_eq_conv_sort : forall Θ Ξ Γ M M' A A' Srt,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A' : Srt ->
    type_sort Srt ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Srt ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A'.
Proof.
  intros * HM HA' HS HAA; eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp; [ exact HM | exact HA' | exact HS |].
  eapply wf_subtyp_refl; [ exact HA' | exact HS | exact HAA ].
Qed.

The Global Context

Presupposition of what each judgment is relative to, and the canonicity that resolution's determinism is stated with. That resolution lands in a well-typed entry is presup_global.
The stack presupposes the filed units with no frame open. This needs nothing from Presup.

Lemma wf_gstack_deps : forall Θ Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ nil.
Proof.
  induction 1; [ constructor | apply wf_gstack_file; assumption | assumption ].
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_gstack_deps : mctt.

Lemma wf_gentry_gctx : forall Θ Ξ mp E, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ E -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ.
Proof.
  induction 1; subst; eauto using ctx_wf_gctx, presup_exp_ctx, presup_ext_eq_ctx, wf_gmod_ctx, presup_is_univ_ctx.
Qed.

Lemma wf_gunit_ctx : forall Θ Ξ mp K U, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⊢ᵍᵘ U -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ frame_params K (gu_params U) ++ gs_tele Ξ.
Proof. eauto using wf_gmod_ctx, wf_gunit_mod. Qed.

Corollary wf_gunit_gctx : forall Θ Ξ mp K U, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⊢ᵍᵘ U -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ.
Proof. eauto using ctx_wf_gctx, wf_gunit_ctx. Qed.

Corollary wf_gmod_gctx : forall Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ.
Proof. eauto using ctx_wf_gctx, wf_gmod_ctx. Qed.

A unit's whole telescope is well formed in its own frame, pushed (wf_gmod_ctx_pushed).
Corollary wf_gunit_ctx_pushed : forall Θ Ξ mp K U, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⊢ᵍᵘ U -> frame_fresh Θ Ξ mp ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ (mp, K, U) :: Ξ ⍮ gu_params U ++ gs_tele Ξ.
Proof. intros * [Δ Φ -> HΦ] Hff; exact (wf_gmod_ctx_pushed _ _ _ _ _ _ HΦ Hff). Qed.

Each judgment presupposes what it is relative to: a term judgment its context, a context the global context, an entry or a unit the global context it is checked against, a module its telescope, the stack the filed units with no frame open. A module's (and a unit's) telescope is presupposed twice: the parameters checked one frame out, there (frame_params: all of them but a record module's value), and the whole telescope in the module's own frame, pushed.
Theorem presup_ambient :
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ) /\
  (forall Θ Ξ Γ A M, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ) /\
